SADA-Merging allocates task-specific subspace capacity according to spectral complexity, adapts spectral preservation according to task-wise plasticity, and applies depth-dependent anchoring to compensate for projection-induced distortion. This enables the fusion process to adapt to both the intrinsic geometry of each task and its sensitivity across network depth. SADA-Merging operates directly on task updates and is applicable to both full fine-tuning and LoRA settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over existing data-free merging methods across different task scales and adaptation settings.

</details>


### [193] [Video-based Surgical Skill Assessment Using Dynamics-and-Uncertainty-Aware Tree-based Gaussian Process Classifier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24619)
*Arefeh Rezaei,Mohammad Javad Ahmadi,Amir Molaei,Hamid D. Taghirad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种结合表征流CNN与动态/不确定性感知的树状高斯过程分类器流水线，用于手术技能评估，兼顾效率、鲁棒性与数据依赖性低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统深度学习方法在手术视频技能评估中依赖大量训练数据、计算开销大，且对时序变化和异常运动转换的鲁棒性不足。

Method: 将表征流卷积神经网络与基于树的、动态与不确定性感知的高斯过程分类器集成。潜运动动态同时用作判别表征与输入不确定性来源；提出语义感知复合核（融合语义、流与动态信息）及不确定性感知核以增强鲁棒性与适用性。

Result: 在JIGSAWS与Cataract-LMM（Capsulorhexis）两个基准数据集上评估。JIGSAWS上LOSO与LOUO协议均表现良好，subject-independent LOUO平均准确率96.9%；within-subject LOSO具竞争力且计算成本大幅降低。

Conclusion: 该流水线为基于视频的手术技能评估提供了一种高效且准确的框架。

Abstract: The proposed pipeline integrates a representation-flow convolutional neural network with a dynamics- and uncertainty-aware tree-based Gaussian Process classifier. In this framework, latent motion dynamics are exploited both as discriminative representations and as a source of input uncertainty, enhancing robustness against temporal variations and abnormal motion transitions. Compared with conventional deep learning approaches, the proposed strategy requires less training data and offers improved computational efficiency. To further improve classification performance, we introduce novel semantic-aware compound kernels that effectively capture semantic, flow, and dynamic information embedded in surgical video features. In addition, uncertainty-aware kernels are developed to strengthen the robustness and practical applicability of the compound kernel framework. The proposed method is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, namely the JIGSAWS and the Cataract-LMM (Capsulorhexis) datasets. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance across both datasets, including the LOSO and LOUO evaluation protocols on JIGSAWS, including the subject-independent LOUO protocol on JIGSAWS, on which the framework attains a mean accuracy of \ph{96.9}\%; results under the within-subject LOSO protocol are reported for comparability with prior work, achieving competitive accuracy while substantially reducing computational cost. Overall, the proposed pipeline provides an efficient and accurate framework for video-based surgical skill assessment.

</details>


### [194] [Relationally Grounded Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24626)
*Fabian Schmidt,Markus Enzweiler,Abhinav Valada*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探究交通场景图能否作为潜在世界模型的特权语义监督，在LAW基础上将场景图关系与视觉潜表示对齐，推理时移除监督分支，在nuScenes上降低轨迹误差与碰撞率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型学习预测表示，但其状态所保留的关系语义通常是隐含的。作者想验证交通场景图能否作为特权语义监督来改善潜在世界表示。

Method: 基于LAW，从nuScenes 3D标注构建以行为主体为中心的场景图，用冻结的文本嵌入模型编码序列化关系结构，在训练时将视觉潜表示与该语义目标对齐；推理时移除监督分支，无需场景图或3D标注，且不增加测试时计算。

Result: 在nuScenes上，相比重新训练的LAW基线，平均轨迹L2误差从0.661降至0.622（5.9%），碰撞率从0.456降至0.217（52.4%）；且优于无结构的caption式语义目标。

Conclusion: 显式关系结构对潜在世界模型的表示学习有益，场景图可作为有效的特权语义监督。

Abstract: Latent world models learn predictive representations for autonomous driving, but the relational semantics these states preserve often remain implicit. We investigate whether traffic scene graphs can serve as privileged semantic supervision for latent world representations. Building on LAW, we construct actor-centric scene graphs from nuScenes 3D annotations, encode their serialized relational structure using a frozen text embedding model, and align the visual latent representations with this semantic target during training. We remove the supervision branch at inference, so it requires neither scene graphs nor 3D annotations and adds no test-time computation. On nuScenes, our method reduces average trajectory L2 error from 0.661 to 0.622 (5.9%) and collision rate from 0.456 to 0.217 (52.4%) relative to our retrained LAW baseline. It also outperforms an unstructured caption-style semantic target, supporting the benefit of explicit relational structure for latent world-model representation learning.

</details>


### [195] [FedMust: Semi-supervised Multi-task Student-Teacher Federated Learning for Multi-organ CT Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24627)
*Ashkan Moradi,Bendik Skarre Abrahamsen,Mattijs Elschot*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出联邦半监督多任务师生框架FedMust，利用各站点有/无标注数据提升多器官分割，平均性能增益13%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多器官分割需大量标注数据，但机构往往缺乏足够多样标注数据；隐私限制阻止数据共享；标注成本高导致仅少量本地数据有标签，大量无标签数据被浪费。

Method: 在各通信轮中，拥有同一任务标签的客户端组成联邦，聚合出教师模型；教师为所有客户端数据生成任务特定特征；所有客户端再组成第二联邦，训练共享编码器+任务特定解码器的多任务学生模型，以复现各分割任务的教师特征；聚合学生模型用于更新本地教师并进入下一轮。

Result: 实验表明方法优于本地及联邦单器官模型，客户端平均性能增益13%；验证了多任务学习与无标签数据的作用，以及放宽客户端参与标注数据要求的适用性。

Conclusion: 该框架能灵活利用跨站点的有标签与无标签数据，在保护隐私前提下提升多器官分割性能，并降低对标注数据的依赖。

Abstract: Multi-organ segmentation using deep learning requires large amounts of annotated patient data; however, institutions often lack sufficiently large and diverse annotated datasets. Privacy constraints further prevent institutions from sharing patient data to overcome this limitation. Moreover, due to the labor-intensive nature of annotation and the scarcity of diverse expertise, institutions typically have labels for only a small portion of their local data, leaving the larger unlabeled portion unused. In this work, we propose a flexible semi-supervised federated multi-task student-teacher framework that leverages federated learning (FL) to improve multi-organ segmentation using both labeled and unlabeled data across participating sites. At each communication round, the proposed framework initiates local training, where clients with labels for the same task form a federation to produce an aggregated teacher model. The resulting teachers generate task-specific features for all data at each client. Subsequently, all clients form a second federation to train a multi-task student model with a shared encoder and task-specific decoders that replicate the teacher-generated features across all segmentation tasks. The aggregated student model is then used to update the local teachers and initiate the next training round. Extensive experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with local and federated single-organ models, yielding an average performance gain of 13 percent across clients. The experiments also demonstrated the impact of multi-task learning and unlabeled data and the applicability of the framework in relaxing labeled-data requirements for client participation. The code is available at https://github.com/AshknMrd/FedMust.

</details>


### [196] [High-resolution Nitrogen Dioxide Maps Reveal Exposure Limit Breaches across Europe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24634)
*Linus Scheibenreif,Konrad Schindler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究用机器学习将地面监测站与卫星、再分析、土地利用、交通及排放数据结合，生成了欧洲小时级、10米分辨率的NO2浓度分布图，并据此评估2030年欧盟新日均限值的达标情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NO2是常见空气污染物，与呼吸及心血管疾病相关。欧盟修订的《环境空气质量指令》(2024/2881)将于2030年起实施NO2日均限值，但现有监管监测网络稀疏，且现有粗分辨率年均模型无法提供评估达标所需的时空分辨率数据。

Method: 构建机器学习模型，融合地面监测站与卫星、再分析、土地利用、交通和排放数据，在每个位置返回经过校准的预测分布，生成欧洲小时级、10米分辨率的NO2地图。用留出的监管监测站和独立公民科学活动进行验证。

Result: 地图能解析欧洲110个都市区的高分辨率NO2时空梯度。重建这些区域的日均合规统计后发现：在监管网络判定为达标的91个EU空气质量区中存在限值超标，覆盖约1.35亿人口；在制图区域内，估计9–9.4%（约2000万）人口生活在日均NO2限值超标地区。

Conclusion: 高分辨率地图为人口尺度的2030年限值达标评估提供了可行途径。

Abstract: Nitrogen dioxide (NO2) is a common air pollutant, released into the atmosphere through the incomplete burning of fossil fuels, and associated with respiratory and cardiovascular diseases in humans. Ambient NO2 concentrations are regulated through air-quality limits assessed with a sparse network of fixed monitors. The revised EU Ambient Air Quality Directive (2024/2881) introduces a daily NO2 limit to be met from 2030. At present, neither the regulatory monitoring network nor existing coarse, annual-mean models can resolve NO2 concentrations at the spatio-temporal resolutions necessary to assess compliance. Here we map NO2 across Europe at hourly and 10m resolution with a machine-learning model that combines ground monitors with satellite, reanalysis, land-use, traffic and emission data and returns a calibrated predictive distribution at every location. Validated against held-out regulatory monitors and independent citizen-science campaigns, the maps resolve high-resolution spatiotemporal NO2 gradients for 110 metropolitan areas in Europe. We reconstruct the daily compliance statistic across those regions and find limit breaches in 91 EU air quality zones deemed compliant by the regulatory monitoring network, covering a population of approximately 135M. Beyond air quality zones and monitor locations, an estimated 9-9.4% (20M) of the population in mapped regions lives in areas where the daily NO2 limit is breached. The high-resolution maps offer a route to population-scale assessment of compliance with the 2030 limits.

</details>


### [197] [Ev-YOLO: Uncertainty-Aware Object Detection via a Unified Evidential Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24668)
*Simon Barbarit-Gaboriau,Hind Laghmara,Rémi Boutteau,Samia Ainouz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出YOLOv8的证据深度学习版本，将分类与边界框回归统一到共同证据框架下，检测精度有竞争力并提供可判别正误的定位不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在自动驾驶等不确定环境中部署目标检测器需可靠的不确定性估计。EDL虽为分类提供原则性框架，但现有证据目标检测器将证据分类与理论根基不同的回归不确定性模型简单结合，缺乏统一性。

Method: 利用YOLOv8基于分布的边界框表示，将证据公式同时应用于分类与定位，使两者均输出信念、不确定性和概率估计，并可纳入Dempster-Shafer框架解释。

Result: 在KITTI、MUSES和nuScenes上，检测精度与标准YOLOv8大致相当，同时提供的定位不确定性可有效区分正确与错误检测；在域偏移下该不确定性判别性更强。

Conclusion: 通过在统一证据框架下建模分类与回归不确定性，提出的证据YOLOv8在保持竞争力的检测性能的同时，提供了理论一致且在实际与域偏移场景下有判别力的不确定性估计。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors in autonomous systems operating in uncertain environments. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) provides a principled framework for uncertainty-aware classification by representing network outputs as evidence and interpreting predictions through subjective logic. However, existing evidential object detectors typically combine evidential classification with regression uncertainty models that do not share the same theoretical foundation. In this work, we propose an evidential version of YOLOv8 in which both classification and bounding-box regression are formulated within a common evidential framework. Our approach exploits YOLOv8's distribution-based bounding-box representation, allowing the evidential formulation to be applied not only to classification but also to localisation. As a result, both tasks produce belief, uncertainty, and probability estimates that can be interpreted within the Dempster--Shafer framework. Experiments on KITTI, MUSES, and nuScenes show that the resulting detector remains broadly competitive with standard YOLOv8 in terms of detection accuracy while providing a localisation uncertainty that effectively discriminates between correct and erroneous detections. Moreover, this uncertainty becomes increasingly discriminative under domain shift.

</details>


### [198] [What Makes a Good Medical Image Tokenizer? Rethinking Reconstruction and Generation in Medical Image Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24691)
*Niklas Bubeck,Yundi Zhang,Vasiliki Sideri-Lampretsa,Julian McGinnis,Jiancheng Yang,Daniel Rueckert,Jiazhen Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评测了医学图像tokenizer，覆盖10个模型族、12个数据集、3种压缩率共30种配置，考察重建、生成、潜空间几何、下游分类与记忆，发现医学图像领域与自然图像不同的若干规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜扩散模型已成为医学图像生成主流，其效果依赖将图像压缩为潜码的tokenizer。医学图像流程通常直接沿用自然图像tokenizer，但医学数据集规模小得多、样本间方差更低，该假设从未在医学领域被验证，因此需要系统评估。

Method: 在12个医学数据集、10个模型族、3种压缩率共30种tokenizer配置上进行统一评测，评估维度包括：图像重建、生成质量、潜空间几何结构、下游分类性能以及训练集记忆程度。

Result: (1) 重建性能与生成质量强相关，与自然图像上的既有报告不同；(2) 现代tokenizer几乎用满码本条目，但潜空间大部分仍未使用；(3) 训练集记忆程度较轻，且更强的潜空间压缩会进一步抑制记忆；(4) 离散量化大多能保持下游分类性能，无查找表（lookup-free）方案是主要例外。

Conclusion: 医学图像不能直接照搬自然图像tokenizer的经验：tokenizer选择需在重建/生成、潜空间利用率、记忆风险与下游任务保留之间权衡，无查找表量化方案在下游分类上尤需谨慎评估。

Abstract: Latent diffusion models now dominate medical image generation, and every such pipeline rests on a \emph{tokenizer} that compresses images into the latent codes for image generation to operate on. Thereby, the tokenizer choice bounds every downstream task from reconstruction fidelity and generation quality to the representations available for downstream analysis. Yet, medical imaging pipelines routinely utilize tokenizers from natural imaging on the hypothesis that their behavior carries over. However, this is an assumption never tested in the medical imaging regime, where datasets are orders of magnitude smaller and images exhibit far lower inter-sample variance. We present a systematic evaluation of medical image tokenizers evaluating thirty configurations across ten model families on twelve datasets at three compression factors, spanning reconstruction, generation, latent geometry, downstream classification, and memorization. We find that (1) performance on image reconstruction and generation strongly correlate, unlike prior reports on natural images; (2) modern tokenizers use nearly all of their codebook entries, but still leave most of the latent space unused; (3) training-set memorization is mild and is further suppressed by stronger latent space compression; and (4) discrete quantization can largely preserve downstream classification, with lookup-free schemes being the main exception.

</details>


### [199] [ReSTI: A Source-Grounded Audit and Repair of STI-Bench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24727)
*Pengzhan Sun,Ramanathan Rajaraman,Shiu-Hong Kao,Junbin Xiao,Angela Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文审计了时空基准STI-Bench，发现其存在系统性坐标系、时间戳、目标定义等错误，并提出ReSTI进行源可追溯的修订。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时空基准只有在问题、源标注和答案选项指向同一物理量时才有效。作者发现STI-Bench存在系统性错误，需要审计和修正。

Method: 对照官方ScanNet、Waymo、Omni6DPose源数据审计STI-Bench，构建ReSTI，在明确的目标、时间、坐标系、物理量和单位下重建每个可恢复答案，并替换有缺陷的标签。

Result: 发现ScanNet Grounding缺失坐标系对齐、Orientation在错误平面上测量相机旋转、Waymo姿态在错误时间戳评估等问题；在2064个旧问题中保留1782个，记录282个有证据的排除。

Conclusion: ReSTI为精确视频时空推理评估提供了保守且源可追溯的基础。

Abstract: Spatial--temporal benchmarks are valid only when their questions, source annotations, and answer options identify the same physical quantity. We audit STI-Bench against the official ScanNet, Waymo, and Omni6DPose sources and find systematic coordinate-system and timestamp errors, under-specified targets and times, and disagreements between keyed options and answer details. We introduce ReSTI, a source-backed revision that reconstructs every recoverable answer under an explicit target, time, coordinate system, physical quantity, and unit. Source reconstruction reveals task-level geometric failures: ScanNet Grounding omits the required alignment between annotation and raw camera coordinate systems, while Orientation measures camera rotation on the wrong plane. ReSTI replaces these labels with explicit, source-consistent geometric definitions and corrects other source-verifiable defects, including Waymo poses evaluated at the wrong timestamp. Across 2,064 legacy questions, ReSTI retains 1,782 questions and records 282 evidence-backed exclusions. ReSTI therefore provides a conservative and source-traceable basis for evaluating precise video spatial--temporal reasoning. Project page: https://github.com/pengzhansun/ReSTI.

</details>


### [200] [GraphSVR: q-Space--Aware Graph-Based Slice-to-Volume Registration for Diffusion MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24732)
*Noga Kertes,Daphna Link Sourani,Alex M. Bronstein,Moti Freiman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GraphSVR，将DWI四维运动配准建模为q空间感知的图神经网络问题，自监督零样本预测全局一致的刚体运动，严重运动下误差较FSL eddy降低73%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DWI对受试者运动高度敏感，尤其在高效协议和易动人群中。SVR可缓解层间/堆叠错位，但DWI的扩散方向依赖对比及需将数十次测量对齐到同一参考帧，构成4D配准难题。现有方法多依赖序列建模或成对相似度，在稀疏梯度采样或严重运动下性能下降。

Method: GraphSVR是一个q空间感知的图框架，用于DWI的4D SVR配准。将切片组作为节点构建采集结构图，边编码时间邻近、空间切片几何和扩散编码关系。用图神经网络预测全局一致的逐堆叠刚体运动，以自监督零样本方式仅用解剖参考图像优化，无需配对真值运动。

Result: 在完全合成的扩散模拟和基于真实采集、可控运动严重程度与梯度稀疏度的重组模拟上评估，用网格误差(mm)和旋转误差衡量。严重运动下较标准方法FSL eddy降低网格误差和旋转误差73%，在稀疏方向情形增益最大。

Conclusion: 通过图推理显式建模采集结构，可提升4D DWI运动估计的鲁棒性与全局一致性。代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) remains highly vulnerable to subject motion, particularly in time-efficient protocols and in motion-prone populations. While slice-to-volume registration (SVR) can mitigate inter-slice and inter-stack misalignment, diffusion MRI introduces additional complexity due to diffusion-direction-dependent contrast and the requirement to align dozens of measurements within a common reference frame, effectively yielding a 4D registration problem. Existing approaches rely primarily on sequential modeling or pairwise similarity and often degrade under sparse gradient sampling or severe motion. We introduce GraphSVR, a q-space-aware graph-based framework for 4D SVR registration in DWI. GraphSVR represents slice groups as nodes in an acquisition-structured graph, with edges encoding temporal proximity, spatial slice geometry and diffusion encoding relationships. A graph neural network predicts globally consistent stack-wise rigid motion, optimized in a self-supervised, zero-shot manner using only an anatomical reference image, without requiring paired ground-truth motion. We evaluate GraphSVR using both fully synthetic diffusion simulations and realistic recombination-based simulations from real acquisitions with controllable motion severity and gradient sparsity. Performance is quantified using grid error (mm) and rotation error relative to known ground-truth transforms. Under severe motion, GraphSVR reduces grid error and rotation error by 73% compared to FSL eddy, the standard DWI motion-correction method, with the largest gains observed in sparse-direction regimes. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling acquisition structure through graph-based reasoning improves robustness and global consistency in 4D DWI motion estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/nogakertes/GraphSVR.git.

</details>


### [201] [MiTHras: Task-specific Hierarchical Semi-supervised Contrastive Masked Autoencoder for Mitotic Figure Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24736)
*Trinh T. L. Vuong,Simon Graham,Quoc Dang Vu,Phat T. H. Ho,Jeewoo Lim,Mostafa Jahanifar,Nasir Rajpoot,Jin T. Kwak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MiTHras，一种任务特异性预训练框架，结合伪标签引导的图像/令牌级对比学习与掩码重建，用于鲁棒的核分裂象分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动核分裂象(MF)分析对肿瘤分级与预后评估很重要，但现有模型对组织类型和图像采集差异敏感。

Method: 构建TCGA-MF-Pseudo语料库（约180万张细胞中心图像，来自14个TCGA队列、11个器官部位），并提出任务特异性预训练框架MiTHras，融合伪标签引导的图像级与令牌级对比学习以及掩码重建。

Result: 在MF分类、检测、基于计数的生存预测和亚型分类上均验证有效；在三个MF分类基准和两个亚型基准上取得最高平均F1；在冻结编码器线性探测下比通用和病理基础编码器提升更明显；检测提升有限（因共享候选检测阶段），消融表明令牌级监督改善典型/非典型分类和线性探测。

Conclusion: MiTHras可为自动化核分裂活性评估提供鲁棒、可迁移的表征。

Abstract: Mitotic figure (MF) analysis supports tumor grading and prognostic assessment, but automated models remain sensitive to differences in tissue type and image acquisition. We present MiTHras, a task-specific pretraining framework that combines pseudo-label-guided image- and token-level contrastive learning with masked reconstruction. We construct TCGA-MF-Pseudo, a corpus of 1.8 million cell-centered images from 14 TCGA cohorts spanning 11 organ sites. Comprehensive evaluation on MF classification, detection, count-based survival prediction, and subtype classification demonstrates the efficacy of MiTHras. It achieves the highest mean F1 on all three MF classification benchmarks and both subtype benchmarks. MiTHras also outperforms general-purpose and pathology foundation encoders by a larger margin under frozen-encoder linear probing than under full fine-tuning. Although detection gains are modest due to a shared candidate-detection stage, ablations confirm that token-level supervision improves typical-versus-atypical classification and linear probing. These findings establish that MiTHras yields robust, transferable representations for automated mitotic activity assessment.

</details>


### [202] [Ananke: Contractive Torus Attractor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24737)
*Zhongping Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出Ananke表示学习框架及其视觉骨干CTAN，将隐空间分解为二维相平面的正交直和（乘积环面先验），用Hamiltonian切向输运与梯度耗散的双相流解耦更新特征，推导出精确对数辛流(ELSF)闭式映射，并在CIFAR-100与Kvasir-v2上以0.27M参数达到90.52%准确率，远超百万级基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表示学习缺乏结构化先验，隐空间几何约束弱，导致参数效率低、语义不变性难以保持。作者希望将隐空间组织到具有几何结构的乘积环面流形上，以解耦方式同时保留语义相位不变量并收缩横向扰动。

Method: 将高维隐空间分解为K个二维相平面的正交直和；采用解耦双相连续流——斜对称Hamiltonian输运沿能量水平集切向移动特征以保持相位不变量，符号梯度耗散法向收缩扰动至目标不变流形。对冻结参数的圆势族，用对数径向反馈得到闭式的精确对数辛流(ELSF)，单次前向即可精确指数衰减对数半径误差，无需数值积分。给出水平集偏差与对数半径误差的局部输入-状态界，分析理想乘积环面在扰动下的法向双曲性与持续性。通过Lie-Trotter算子分裂统一空间深度扩散与局部流形收缩，并分析精确三角流与硬件友好的辛双剪切变体。

Result: 在CIFAR-100和Kvasir-v2上验证：仅0.27M参数的超紧凑分层模型在Kvasir-v2达90.52%准确率，超越ResNet-50、DenseNet-161等25M+基线近两个数量级容量；放大变体在CIFAR-100达80.32% top-1准确率。

Conclusion: 将隐表示脚手架于结构化乘积环面先验、以辛/耗散耦合动力系统驱动特征演化，可实现极高参数效率与强泛化，为几何先验驱动的表示学习与高效视觉骨干提供理论与实证支撑。

Abstract: We introduce Ananke, a representation-learning framework that scaffolds latent representations onto a structured product-torus prior, and its flagship visual backbone realization, Contractive Torus Attractor Networks (CTAN). By factorizing high-dimensional latent spaces into an orthogonal direct sum of two-dimensional phase planes ($\bigoplus_{k=1}^K \R^2$), Ananke coordinates feature updates via a decoupled dual-phase continuous flow: skew-symmetric Hamiltonian transport moves features tangentially along energy level sets to preserve semantic phase invariants, while signed gradient dissipation contracts transverse perturbations normally toward target invariant manifolds. For circular potential families with frozen parameters, logarithmic radial feedback yields the Exact Log-Symplectic Flow (ELSF), an analytical closed-form mapping with exact exponential decay of log-radius error that evaluates in a single forward pass without numerical integration. We establish local input-to-state bounds for level-set deviations and log-radius errors, and characterize the normal hyperbolicity and persistence of the ideal product torus under bounded perturbations. We further formulate the architecture through Lie--Trotter operator splitting, unifying spatial depthwise diffusion with local manifold contraction, and analyze both exact trigonometric flows and hardware-friendly symplectic dual-shear variants. Across natural image benchmarks (CIFAR-100) and clinically challenging endoscopy datasets (Kvasir-v2), CTAN demonstrates exceptional parameter efficiency: an ultra-compact hierarchical model with merely 0.27M parameters achieves 90.52\% accuracy on Kvasir-v2, outperforming 25M+ baselines (ResNet-50, DenseNet-161) by nearly two orders of magnitude in capacity, while scaled variants attain 80.32\% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-100.

</details>


### [203] [PrismGPT: Proxy-Guided Learning for Region-Aware Photo Editing with Self-Synthesized Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24768)
*Ke Zhao,Hue Nguyen,Abhijith Punnappurath,Zhongling Wang,Iqbal Mohomed,Michael S. Brown*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PrismGPT，一个VLM框架，能从单张图像生成结构化、区域感知的编辑方案，实现全局与局部润色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业照片润色依赖全局调整与语义掩膜引导的局部编辑，但现有自动化方法仅能部分覆盖该流程；训练VLM同时诊断全局与局部美学缺陷并预测精确参数，面临庞大的组合决策空间。

Method: 采用代理引导学习：操作分解与区域感知美学排序两个代理任务教授基础能力；基于能力的动态调度器自动调整多任务训练比例，随技能掌握逐步从代理任务转向主编辑任务。所有SFT推理轨迹由同一基础模型自合成，无需更强外部教师。

Result: 在MIT-Adobe FiveK及新提出的专业润色基准SPIRE上，PrismGPT达到SOTA，且训练数据仅为先前最佳方法的约6%。

Conclusion: PrismGPT通过代理引导学习与自合成推理轨迹，有效实现区域感知的自动专业照片润色，兼具高性能与高数据效率。

Abstract: Professional photo finishing relies on both global adjustments and region-specific local edits guided by semantic masks, yet current automated methods handle this workflow only partially. We present PrismGPT, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) framework that produces structured, region-aware editing plans from a single input image without relying on commercial black-box tools. Training a VLM to simultaneously diagnose aesthetic deficiencies at both global and local levels while predicting precise editing parameters is challenging due to the vast combinatorial decision space. We address this through proxy-guided learning: two simpler proxy tasks -- operation decomposition and region-aware aesthetic ranking -- teach the foundational skills the model needs, while a competence-based dynamic scheduler automatically rebalances the multi-task training ratio, progressively shifting emphasis from the proxy tasks to the primary editing task as each skill is mastered. Crucially, all reasoning traces used for supervised fine-tuning are self-synthesized by the same base model, eliminating the need for a stronger external teacher. Experiments on MIT-Adobe FiveK and SPIRE, a new professionally retouched benchmark we introduce, show that PrismGPT achieves state-of-the-art results while using only ~6% of the training data compared to the previous best method.

</details>


### [204] [Brain Metastases Segmentation for BraTS 2026 Task 1: A Multi-Architecture Comparison](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24769)
*Mahdi Islam,Musarrat Tabassum*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 比较多种模型用于脑转移瘤分割（BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1），并报告后处理陷阱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑转移瘤是最常见颅内恶性肿瘤，约30%实体瘤患者发生，中位生存期约5.9个月。自动分割对治疗规划和体积监测至关重要，但转移灶常小而多、大小异质。

Method: 对比四种方法：普通nnU-Net基线、ResEncL变体、区域训练、Primus transformer。采用按患者分组交叉验证以避免UCSD纵向子集泄漏。

Result: Primus（基于标签）综合DSC/NSD最佳：ET 0.710/0.761，TC 0.742/0.785，WT 0.683/0.689，RC 0.531/0.436。ResEncL综合略低但病灶级F1高得多（ET 0.452 vs 0.052）。两模型概率平均集成仅部分保留ResEncL的F1优势（ET病灶F1降至0.064）。

Conclusion: Primus综合指标最强，ResEncL在病灶级检测更优；集成难以兼顾两者优势，并指出三个可推广的后处理与标签重建陷阱。

Abstract: Brain metastases are the most common intracranial malignancy, occurring in roughly 30% of patients with primary solid tumors and carrying a median survival near 5.9 months. Automated segmentation is critical for treatment planning and volumetric monitoring, but metastases are frequently small, numerous, and heterogeneous in size within a single patient. We compare a plain nnU-Net baseline, a Residual Encoder Large (ResEncL) variant, region-based training, and a Primus transformer model for BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1, using patient-grouped cross-validation to prevent leakage from the longitudinal UCSD subset. Primus (label-based) is our strongest individual model by aggregate DSC/NSD, achieving 0.710/0.761 (ET), 0.742/0.785 (TC), 0.683/0.689 (WT), and 0.531/0.436 (RC). ResEncL trails Primus on aggregate DSC/NSD but achieves substantially higher lesion-wise F1 (e.g. ET: 0.452 vs. 0.052); a probability-averaging ensemble of the two only partially preserves ResEncL's F1 advantage (ET lesion-wise F1: 0.064). We further report three postprocessing and label-reconstruction pitfalls we believe generalize beyond this challenge. Code is available at https://github.com/mahdiislam79/BraTS_METS_2026.

</details>


### [205] [Virtual neural networks: hundreds of souls in a body](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24782)
*Petr Hurtik,Marek Vajgl,Zahra Alijani,Vojtech Molek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"虚拟神经网络"概念：可训练参数恒定，通过计算资源实现可扩展性。结合孪生网络与深度集成，由少量物理模型共享权重生成大量虚拟模型，集成数百个模型提升鲁棒性与精度，性能超越大容量模型、深度集成及SWA、Masksembles等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统模型提升性能依赖增加可训练参数（扩大模型容量），计算与存储成本高。作者希望在不增加参数量的前提下，纯粹依靠计算资源来获得可扩展性和更强鲁棒性。

Method: 提出虚拟神经网络抽象框架（可用标准CNN实现）。将孪生神经网络与深度集成技术结合，由一小组物理模型共享权重生成大量虚拟模型（集成可达上百个）。所有虚拟网络共享同一输入，其互连结构产生内部失真以增强整体集成鲁棒性。

Result: 集成精度随虚拟网络数量增加而提升，且不改变模型容量。虚拟神经网络优于更大容量的模型、典型深度集成及SWA、Masksembles等当代方法；集成中表现最好的单个模型也超越其他单独训练的模型（即使后者参数更多）。

Conclusion: 虚拟神经网络证明可保持参数量恒定、依靠计算资源扩展性能，是一种通用且有效的框架，能在不增加容量的情况下实现强鲁棒性与高精度。代码已开源。

Abstract: A new concept, termed virtual neural networks, is introduced, where the count of trainable parameters is kept constant, and scalability is attained purely through computational resources. This concept is an abstract framework that can be realized using any standard convolutional neural network. It merges siamese neural networks with a deep ensemble technique by generating numerous virtual models that share weights derived from a small set of physical models. The ensemble comprises up to hundreds of trained models simultaneously. All virtual networks take the same input, and their interconnected structure induces an internal distortion that boosts the entire ensemble robustness. The accuracy of the ensemble improves as the number of virtual networks increases, without changing the capacity. Virtual neural networks outperform larger capacity models, typical deep ensembles, and contemporary approaches like SWA and Masksembles. Additionally, the highest-performing individual model from the ensemble surpasses other models trained individually, even those with a greater number of parameters. Code: gitlab.com/EnginCZ/virtual-models-public

</details>


### [206] [Toward a foundation model for forest point clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24787)
*Yuanwen Yue,Stefano Puliti,Damien Robert,Atakan Topaloğlu,Binbin Xiang,Maciej Wielgosz,Jan Dirk Wegner,Rasmus Astrup,Christian Rupprecht,Konrad Schindler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探索面向3D林业的基础模型（FM），以LitePT为骨干，构建大规模无标注点云语料并进行自监督预训练，系统比较不同表征学习策略在4类林业任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有林业AI模型通常针对单一任务、传感器和森林类型专门化，适配成本高（标注、算力、专业知识）。作者希望验证单一预训练模型能否学习跨多样林业场景的可迁移表征。

Method: 以LitePT为骨干：1）先建立强监督基线；2）构建涵盖机载、无人机、移动激光扫描的跨生态系统大规模无标注语料；3）用自监督学习预训练；4）在4类代表性林业任务、不同标注预算下比较从头训练、监督预训练和自监督预训练。

Result: 监督基线在森林语义/实例分割、树种分类和树龄回归基准上取得新SOTA。自监督预训练相比从头训练加速收敛，在标注稀缺时持续提升性能；相比任务特定监督预训练，产生更可迁移的跨任务表征。

Conclusion: 明确了预训练表征最有价值的实用场景；指出实例判别（而非森林语义）是构建通用3D森林基础模型的主要障碍。代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Forest inventories increasingly rely on artificial intelligence (AI) models to derive forest attributes from large-scale 3D point clouds. Current models are typically specialized to a single task, sensor, and forest type, making adaptation expensive in terms of annotations, computation, and expertise. We ask whether a single pretrained model can instead learn transferable representations across diverse forest inventory settings. Inspired by recent developments in language modelling and computer vision, we take a step toward a foundation model (FM) for 3D forestry. Using LitePT as backbone, we first establish a strong supervised baseline that sets a new state of the art on forest semantic and instance segmentation, tree species classification, and age regression benchmarks. We then curate a large-scale unlabelled corpus spanning airborne, UAV, and mobile laser scanning across diverse forest ecosystems, and pretrain the same backbone using self-supervised learning. We systematically evaluate representation learning strategies by comparing training from scratch, supervised pretraining, and self-supervised pretraining across four representative forestry tasks, under varying annotation budgets. Compared with training from scratch, self-supervised pretraining accelerates model convergence and consistently improves performance when annotations are scarce. Compared with task-specific supervised pretraining, self-supervised pretraining yields more transferable representations across downstream forestry tasks. These findings identify the practical regime in which pretrained representations are most valuable and suggest that instance discrimination, rather than forest semantics, is the main remaining obstacle to a general-purpose 3D forest foundation model. Code and models are available at: https://github.com/prs-eth/ForPT.

</details>


### [207] [Streaming Video Editing with Easy Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24788)
*Yujia Hu,Jiajun Li,Zihao He,Songhua Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SVEET：在预训练双向视频扩散模型上训练，实现高质量自回归流式视频编辑，单张H100达15 FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频到视频扩散方法难以直接用于流式（自回归）视频编辑，需解决双向与流式模型间的差异问题。

Method: 基于两大原则——主干特征解耦与条件帧独立性：用辅助模型分支以时间独立自注意力编码源视频，将中间特征注入对应主干块；并提出解耦训练方案，强制视频可控性与模型因果性优化方向正交，实现跨异构主干的零样本知识迁移。

Result: 在保持实时性能下实现更优编辑质量，单张H100 GPU无需辅助加速即达15 FPS。

Conclusion: SVEET为高质量流式视频编辑提供了有效方案，通过特征解耦与解耦训练实现双向到流式模型的高效适配。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose SVEET, a framework that requires merely training on a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model but supports high-quality streaming video editing in an auto-regressive fashion. To tackle this problem, we first systematically revisit existing video-to-video diffusion approaches and identify two key principles for such streaming adaptation: backbone feature disentanglement and conditional frame independence. Building on these insights, we develop a novel paradigm for controllable video generation. At its core, an auxiliary model branch encodes source video inputs with temporally independent self-attention, and the intermediate features are injected into the corresponding backbone blocks for streaming-compatible control. Moreover, to bridge the discrepancy between the feature spaces of bidirectional and streaming models, we propose a decoupled training scheme that explicitly enforces the orthogonality between the optimization directions of video controllability and model causality. Such disentanglement ensures compatibility between the two objectives at inference and facilitates smooth zero-shot knowledge transfer across heterogeneous backbone architectures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SVEET achieves superior editing quality while maintaining real-time performance, attaining 15 FPS on a single H100 GPU 17 without any auxiliary acceleration techniques. Codes are available at https://github.com/YujiaHu1109/SVEET.

</details>


### [208] [INTCORT: Training-Free Spatial Reasoning Enhancement for Vision-Language Models via Input Transformations and Confidence Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24813)
*Haoran Sun,Jingqi Xu,Yanhui Li,Enci Liu,Kaidi Xu,Yanwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练空间推理增强框架INTCORT，通过输入变换构建多推理视图并用关系token置信度路由聚合预测，平均提升10.01%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在多模态任务表现优异，但空间推理能力差。现有依赖训练的方法计算成本高且灾难性遗忘，免训练方法则干扰内部机制、损害通用能力。

Method: 先验证两个假设：适当的几何图像变换与查询反转变换可纠正错误的空间预测；正确预测的关系token置信度高于错误预测。基于此，INTCORT通过输入变换构建多个推理视图，并用关系token置信度路由聚合预测，不修改VLM内部机制。

Result: 在多个常用基准和多种VLM上大幅提升空间推理准确率，所有模型与基准平均提升10.01%，相比既有工作最高提升25.01%。

Conclusion: INTCORT是一种有效的免训练空间推理增强框架，性能优于现有方法，且不改变模型内部机制。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal tasks, yet they still exhibit poor ability in spatial reasoning. Existing training-dependent and training-free enhancement methods suffer from high computational costs with catastrophic forgetting and internal mechanism interference that compromises general capabilities, respectively. In this work, we first verify two key hypotheses: appropriate geometric image transformation and query-reversal transformation can recover incorrect spatial predictions, and correct predictions exhibit higher relation-token confidence than incorrect ones. Based on these findings, we propose INTCORT, a training-free spatial reasoning enhancement framework that constructs multiple inference views through input transformations and aggregates their predictions via relation-token confidence routing, without modifying the VLM's internal mechanisms. Experimental results on several commonly-used benchmarks demonstrate that INTCORT substantially improves spatial reasoning accuracy across diverse VLMs, achieving an average improvement of 10.01% over all models and benchmarks. Compared with prior works, INTCORT achieves superior performance with improvements of up to 25.01%.

</details>


### [209] [Mobile Imaging Solutions for Medical Diagnosis: Trends and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24814)
*Syed Muhammad Ibne Zulfiker,Tanzima Hashem,Fariha Tabassum Islam,Md Sultanul Arifin,Khandker Aftarul Islam,Nishat Anjum Bristy,Faria Huq,Priyeta Saha,Syeda Nahida Akter,Arpita Saha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 一篇综述，系统梳理基于手机等移动设备图像的医疗诊断研究，跨病种对比现有方案的优势与局限，提炼理想诊断工具特征，并指出挑战与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动设备算力、摄像头与图像分析技术日趋成熟，使智能手机、笔记本等非医疗设备有望用于低成本、可及的医疗诊断，尤其惠及偏远和资源匮乏地区的人群，因此有必要对已有研究做系统总结。

Method: 综述方法：对现有移动图像医疗诊断研究进行文献梳理，按不同医疗应用类别对比最新方案（state-of-the-art），分析其优缺点，并归纳理想工具应具备的特征。

Result: 覆盖眼科与耳鼻喉疾病、营养不良、心率变异性、皮肤与口腔疾病、创伤等多种病种；指出现有方法已取得进展的领域及仍需深入研究的方向，并总结应用特定与共通的挑战。

Conclusion: 移动图像医疗方案在支持低成本疾病诊断与监测方面潜力巨大，可为远程及资源受限地区的欠发达人群提供可及的医疗服务，同时明确了未来研究方向。

Abstract: Advances in processing power, camera technologies, and mobile image analysis have made smartphones and other mobile devices, such as laptops, increasingly suitable for medical diagnosis and healthcare applications. Researchers have developed low-cost solutions for the early detection and monitoring of various health conditions, including eye and ENT diseases, malnutrition, heart rate variability, skin and oral conditions, and injuries, using images captured by non-medical devices such as smartphones and webcams. This survey examines existing research on mobile image-based medical diagnosis, with an emphasis on its potential to enable low-cost and accessible healthcare. We comparatively analyze state-of-the-art solutions across different healthcare application categories, examining their advantages and limitations. Based on this analysis, we identify desirable characteristics of mobile image-based diagnostic tools and highlight areas where existing approaches have made progress as well as areas requiring further research. We also discuss application-specific and common challenges and outline directions for future research. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive overview of mobile image-based healthcare solutions and their potential to support low-cost disease diagnosis and monitoring, particularly for underserved populations in remote and resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [210] [ZVeC: A Zero-Shot Framework for Instance-Level Vehicle Extraction and Generative Point Cloud Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24825)
*Daisy Li,Kyle Gao,Quanyun Wu,Boris Jutzi,John S. Zelek,Jonathan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZVeC：一种零样本、实例驱动的框架，将场景级点云补全重构为组合式的物体级重建，利用扩散模型对每个分割出的车辆独立补全，再重组回场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地下环境中的LiDAR点云因遮挡和视角受限存在严重几何不完整，且缺乏大规模监督数据集，使可靠的点云补全非常困难。

Method: 将场景分解为语义物体实例，对每个分割出的车辆使用以深度和3D高斯为条件的扩散模型独立补全，利用通用几何先验后，再将实例重组回原场景；无需场景特定训练。

Result: 在自建真实地下停车场密集LiDAR基准上，量化指标和视觉质量均持续优于代表性场景级基线。补全点云与输入差异显著（平均KL约2.1），但将输入降至原LiDAR测量的1%时补全结果变化很小（KL<0.50）。

Conclusion: ZVeC在极端输入稀疏条件下仍能产生几何一致的补全，验证了其零样本、实例驱动方法的有效性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: LiDAR point clouds acquired in underground environments exhibit severe geometric incompleteness due to occlusions and limited sensor viewpoints, making reliable point cloud completion challenging without large supervised datasets. We propose ZVeC, a zero-shot, instance-driven framework that reformulates scene-level completion as compositional object-level reconstruction. By decomposing a scene into semantic object instances, ZVeC reduces reconstruction ambiguity in cluttered environments while eliminating the need for scenario-specific training. Each segmented vehicle is completed independently using a depth- and 3D Gaussian-conditioned diffusion model that exploits generalized geometric priors before the reconstructed instances are recomposed into the original scene. To evaluate our approach, we construct a real-world dense LiDAR benchmark of underground parking environments. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over representative scene-level baselines in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. The completed point cloud differs substantially from the measured input (average KL divergence ~ 2.1), yet reducing the input to only 1% of the original LiDAR measurements changes the completed reconstruction only marginally (KL divergence < 0.50). This demonstrates that ZVeC produces geometrically consistent completions even under extreme input sparsity.

</details>


### [211] [When Wider Views Fail: Stress-Testing Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24839)
*Daisy Li,Kyle Gao,Quanyun Wu,Hanna Chomko,John S. Zelek,Jonathan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究前馈3D重建模型在视角变化（受控分布偏移）下的失效模式，发现视角跨度增大导致重建质量显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3D重建模型虽能从稀疏图像高效估计几何，但其预训练特性使其对训练数据之外的分布偏移敏感。识别这些失效模式对于理解模型在无约束成像环境中的可靠性至关重要。

Method: 将视角变化作为受控分布偏移：在固定输入图像数量的前提下，改变稀疏输入图像的角跨度，对多个前馈重建模型进行评测。

Result: 随视角跨度增大，多个模型性能大幅退化；宽跨度不仅导致表面覆盖不完整，还产生缺乏观测图像支撑的几何（几何幻觉）。

Conclusion: 视角变化会引发超出传统重建不完整性的新失效模式，表明需在挑战其学习几何先验的分布偏移下评测预训练前馈模型。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models enable efficient geometry estimation from sparse images, but their pretrained nature can make them vulnerable to distribution shifts beyond their training data. Identifying these failure modes is important for understanding when such models can be reliably deployed in unconstrained imaging settings. We investigate viewpoint variation as a controlled distribution shift by varying the angular span of sparse image inputs while keeping the input budget fixed. Across multiple feed-forward reconstruction models, we observe substantial degradation as viewpoint span increases, with wide spans producing both incomplete surface coverage and geometry unsupported by the observed imagery. These results reveal that viewpoint variation can induce failure modes beyond conventional reconstruction incompleteness, highlighting the need to evaluate pretrained feed-forward models under distribution shifts that challenge their learned geometric priors.

</details>


### [212] [Revisiting Multi-View Stereo: A Sequence-to-Sequence Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24850)
*Aoxiang Fan,Corentin Dumery,Nicolas Talabot,Pascal Fua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对已知相机参数的多视图立体（MVS）问题，提出将MVS从"序列到单一"重构为"序列到序列"任务，结合全局Transformer架构与相机先验（射线图嵌入和统一全局代价体），在多视图上联合预测几何，取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多视图重建方法存在几何畸变问题：前馈（FF）模型虽能联合估计几何与相机参数，但即使提供真值相机参数仍会因重建歧义导致畸变。作者希望弥合传统MVS与前馈方法之间的差距，充分利用已知相机参数提升精度。

Method: 将MVS重新表述为类似FF模型的序列到序列任务，对所有输入视图联合预测几何，而非仅对单个参考视图预测深度。提出基于全局Transformer的架构，含两个显式利用相机先验的组件：(1) 射线图嵌入（ray-map embeddings），将相机参数注入图像块token中，使Transformer具备相机感知能力；(2) 统一全局代价体，替代传统逐视图代价体，联合捕获所有视图的3D结构。

Result: 在多个公开基准上的大量实验表明，该方法达到最先进性能，超越了传统MVS和前馈重建两方面的基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过将已知相机参数的MVS建模为序列到序列任务并引入相机感知的全局Transformer架构与全局代价体，有效解决了重建歧义导致的几何畸变，验证了融合传统MVS与前馈方法的有效性。

Abstract: Computing accurate geometry from multi-view images is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Recent feed-forward (FF) models jointly estimate 3D geometry and camera parameters, but they typically suffer from geometry distortion caused by reconstruction ambiguity, even when ground-truth camera parameters are supplied. In this paper, we study the multi-view stereo (MVS) problem with known camera parameters and propose a novel approach that bridges conventional MVS and FF methods. Rather than casting MVS as a sequence-to-one mapping that predicts depth only for a single reference view, we reformulate it as a sequence-to-sequence task, akin to FF models, that jointly predicts geometry for all input views. We introduce a global transformer-based architecture with two components that explicitly exploit camera-induced priors: ray-map embeddings that inject camera parameters into image patch tokens, making the transformer camera-aware, and a unified global cost volume that replaces conventional per-view cost volumes to jointly capture 3D structure across all views. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks show our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing both MVS and FF reconstruction baselines.

</details>


### [213] [DTKDP: A Dual Teacher Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight Oriented SAR Ship Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24872)
*Yuming Li,Fan Zhang,Alin M. Achim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DTKDP双教师知识蒸馏与剪枝框架，用于轻量化有向SAR船舶检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两阶段有向检测器精度高但骨干、特征金字塔、候选框模块和RoI头庞大，难以部署；现有轻量SAR检测器多为单阶段，缺乏候选级精确有向定位。

Method: 在卷积、归一化和线性层引入可学习门控以剪枝卷积通道和RoI头神经元；提出旋转候选对齐（RPA），在教师生成的共享旋转候选空间中蒸馏师生预测；采用同构主教师提供分类与回归指导、异构辅助教师补充分类线索的双教师方案。

Result: 在SSDD和RSDD-SAR上，Oriented R-CNN与RoI Transformer（ResNet-50）参数量减少87.5-91.8%，FLOPs减少75.6-79.9%；AP50、AP75、mAP50:75、mAP50:95相对变化从-2.38%到+0.65%；较RTMDet-tiny四项指标提升0.52-27.55%，并持续优于代表性蒸馏方法。

Conclusion: DTKDP实现了精度与效率的良好权衡，可获得接近全尺寸模型精度的高效轻量有向SAR船舶检测器。

Abstract: Two-stage oriented detectors achieve high localization accuracy in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) ship detection, but their large backbones, feature pyramids, proposal modules, and heavy region of interest (RoI) heads hinder deployment. Existing lightweight SAR ship detectors typically use one-stage frameworks that lack proposal-level refinement for precise rotated localization. This paper presents a dual-teacher knowledge distillation and pruning (DTKDP) framework for lightweight oriented SAR ship detection. DTKDP introduces learnable gates into convolutional, normalization, and linear layers to prune convolutional channels and RoI-head neurons. Rotated proposal alignment (RPA) distills teacher and student predictions in a shared teacher-generated rotated proposal space, while a dual-teacher scheme combines classification and regression guidance from a homogeneous main teacher with complementary classification cues from a heterogeneous auxiliary teacher. Experiments on the SAR Ship Detection Dataset (SSDD) and Rotated Ship Detection Dataset in SAR Images (RSDD-SAR) show that DTKDP reduces the parameters of Oriented Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (Oriented R-CNN) and RoI Transformer equipped with ResNet-50 backbones by 87.5-91.8% and their floating-point operations (FLOPs) by 75.6-79.9%. In terms of average precision (AP) and mean average precision (mAP), the resulting Oriented R-CNN-slim and RoI Transformer-slim retain accuracy close to their full-scale counterparts. Relative changes across $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$, $\mathrm{AP}_{75}$, $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:75}$, and $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:95}$ range from a 2.38% decrease to a 0.65% improvement. Compared with RTMDet-tiny, they improve all four metrics on both datasets by 0.52-27.55% and consistently surpass representative distillation methods, demonstrating a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [214] [SPHQuant: Efficient extreme low bit weight quantization for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24875)
*Kewei Zhang,Zheng Chen,Haotong Qin,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPHQuant：一种免旋转的球面权重量化框架，通过将8D权重向量分解为符号、半径和单位方向，实现对VLM的极低比特量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM的语言主干内存占用大、自回归解码受内存限制，难以边缘部署。极低比特量化中，免旋转方法在2-3比特受离群值影响，旋转方法则增加运行时开销。

Method: 将每个8D权重向量分解为坐标符号、半径和正的单位方向；将离群值幅度隔离到半径，对半径分配额外精度；使用紧凑正向方向码本，并通过角度参数化微调码本以保持单位球约束；设计硬件友好的GEMV内核，使方向码本适合共享内存查找并高效打包径向比特。

Result: 性能与SOTA极低比特量化方法相当，在RTX A6000上解码吞吐量比QTIP提升30.3%。

Conclusion: SPHQuant在不增加旋转开销的情况下实现了VLM的高效极低比特量化，兼顾精度与解码速度。

Abstract: Recent foundation models are moving toward native multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs), making VLMs a central form of next-generation foundation models. However, their large language backbones make edge deployment difficult due to high memory footprint and memory-bound autoregressive decoding. Weight-only post-training quantization is a practical solution, but pushing VLMs to extreme low bit-widths remains challenging: existing rotation-free methods suffer from outliers at 2-3 bits, while rotation-based methods improve accuracy at the cost of additional runtime overhead. We propose SPHQuant, a rotation-free spherical weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. Instead of quantizing weights directly in Cartesian coordinates, SPHQuant decomposes each 8D weight vector into coordinate signs, radius, and a positive unit direction. This representation isolates outlier magnitude into the radius while keeping directions bounded and statistically regular. Based on this insight, SPHQuant allocates extra precision to the radius to mitigate accuracy degradation induced by outliers. It further uses a compact positive-direction codebook and fine-tunes codebook entries through angular parameterization to preserve the unit-sphere constraint. We also design a hardware-friendly GEMV kernel that keeps the direction codebook small enough for shared-memory lookup and packs radial bits efficiently. Experiments show that SPHQuant matches the performance of state-of-the-art extreme low-bit quantization methods while improving decode throughput over QTIP by 30.3% on RTX A6000. Code will be released in https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant.

</details>


### [215] [Generating Chest X-Ray Counterfactuals by Specialising Foundation Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24879)
*Xiaodan Xing,Rajat R. Rasal,Julia A. Meister,Sara Ghorayeb,Galvin Khara,Jessica Schrouff*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出specialisation框架，将预训练非因果生成模型适配为因果机制，构建RadCF反事实图像生成模型，在胸部X光上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实图像生成方法虽有进步，但在医疗应用中受限于标注数据稀缺、数据集分布偏移，以及预训练生成模型与反事实推断所需模型不匹配。

Method: 提出specialisation——数据与参数高效的框架，在分布偏移下将预训练、非因果生成模型适配为因果机制；基于此用latent flow matching训练放射学反事实生成模型RadCF。

Result: 在三个胸部X光数据集上（覆盖不同分布偏移、数据量和反事实问题，涉及高局部化干预）验证，RadCF和specialisation在数据与参数高效的同时优于现有方法，提升反事实合理性，且生成的反事实能检测并缓解下游医疗分类器的捷径学习。

Conclusion: specialisation框架可高效适配预训练生成模型用于反事实推断，RadCF在医疗反事实生成中有效，并能辅助发现和缓解捷径学习，代码已开源。

Abstract: Counterfactual image generation answers questions about how a subject would have looked under retrospective, hypothetical scenarios. Recent methods have improved perceptual quality, identity preservation and faithfulness to an underlying causal model, but their adoption in healthcare is limited by scarce annotated data, distribution shift between datasets, and mismatches between pretrained generative models and those required for counterfactual inference. We propose specialisation, a data and parameter-efficient framework for adapting pretrained, non-causal generative models into causal mechanisms under distribution shift. Based on this framework, we train a radiology counterfactual image generation model, called RadCF, using latent flow matching. We validate our approach on three chest X-ray datasets spanning different dataset shifts, data volumes, and counterfactual questions, associated with challenging, highly-localised interventions. Our results show that RadCF and specialisation improve counterfactual soundness over existing methods while being data and parameter efficient, and that the resulting counterfactuals can detect and mitigate shortcut learning in a downstream medical classifier. Code is available at https://github.com/GSK-AI/RadCF/.

</details>


### [216] [PixelDiT2: Representation-Grounded Pixel Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24919)
*Yongsheng Yu,Wei Xiong,Yichen Sheng,Shiqiu Liu,Jiebo Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PixelDiT2像素空间扩散模型，通过"表征接地"用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型提供逐块表征引导，将表征学习与像素生成解耦，无需自编码器即可显著加速收敛并提升图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素空间扩散虽在图像质量上接近潜空间扩散，但收敛更慢、最终质量偏低。作者认为关键原因是缺乏显式表征先验：潜空间扩散在紧凑结构化的潜空间中去噪，而像素扩散需同时从原始RGB空间学习"利于去噪的表征"和像素生成。

Method: 提出端到端的像素空间扩散模型PixelDiT2，在不引入自编码器或潜重建瓶颈的前提下解耦表征学习与像素生成。核心是"表征接地"（representation grounding）：用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型在去噪全过程提供逐块（per-patch）显式表征引导，使像素扩散Transformer更专注于像素生成。

Result: 在ImageNet-256x256上，600个epoch后FID达1.46；在512x512分辨率上，680个epoch后FID达1.48。

Conclusion: 通过引入显式表征先验并解耦表征与生成学习，PixelDiT2在像素空间实现了领先的图像生成质量和更快的收敛，验证了表征接地策略的有效性。

Abstract: Recent advances in pixel-space diffusion models have narrowed the image quality gap with latent-space diffusion, but still converge more slowly and lag behind in final image quality. We argue that a key reason is the lack of an explicit representation prior: unlike latent diffusion, which usually denoises in a compact and structured latent space, pixel diffusion needs to learn denoising-friendly representations and pixel generation simultaneously from raw RGB space. To address this problem, we propose PixelDiT2, an end-to-end pixel-space diffusion model designed to decouple representation learning from pixel generation without introducing an autoencoder or latent reconstruction bottleneck. We propose representation grounding that uses a frozen pretrained vision foundation model to provide explicit per-patch representation guidance throughout denoising, allowing the pixel diffusion transformer to focus more on pixel generation. On ImageNet-256x256, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.46 after 600 epochs; at 512x512 resolution, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.48 after 680 epochs.

</details>


### [217] [Anatomy-Decomposed Chest Computed Tomography (CT) Projections as Scalable Supervision for Bone Suppression in Chest Radiographs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24937)
*Mrunmay Angaitkar,Piyush Kumar,Aarjav Satia,Pranav Rao,Ashish Mittal,Manoj Tadepalli,Preetham Putha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于DRR框架，将胸部CT转为配对监督数据，实现骨骼和肺成分抑制，无需真实配对训练数据即可迁移到真实X光片。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸片中骨骼重叠会遮挡异常，但配对的骨骼抑制训练数据稀缺，限制了监督学习方法。

Method: 用DRR框架把CT分解为骨骼、非肺软组织、肺三部分并分别投影，加权组合得到像素配准且可精确求和的合成影像；模型预测目标成分并通过相减恢复其余部分。扩展部分用真实胸片输出作为目标域做无配对、成分级DRR翻译。

Result: 在多个公开数据集的下游检测中，骨骼抑制对骨骼重叠显著的异常提升明显；未修改的DRR真实感与标签相关解剖保留度可比开源引擎，翻译后DRR在FID、肺野清晰度和源CT解剖一致性上最佳。

Conclusion: 该框架可在无真实配对数据下实现有效的成分抑制，并提升X光异常检测能力，代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Bone overlap can obscure abnormalities in chest radiographs, while scarce paired training data limit supervised bone suppression. We address this challenge with a digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) framework that converts chest computed tomography (CT) into paired supervision for component suppression. A novel bone segmentation algorithm enables CT decomposition into bone, non-lung soft-tissue, and lung components, which are projected separately. Their weighted combination yields synthetic radiographs with pixel-registered component images that sum exactly to the full DRR. Models trained on these data suppress bone or lung components by predicting the target component and recovering the remainder by subtraction, transferring to real radiographs without real paired training data. As an extension, their outputs on real radiographs provide target domains for unpaired, component-wise DRR translation, reducing the appearance gap while retaining anatomical details. Across multiple public datasets, downstream detection experiments demonstrate the utility of bone suppression, with gains concentrated on abnormalities with substantial bone overlap. Compared with open-source DRR engines applied to the same CTs, our unmodified DRRs achieve comparable realism and preservation of label-relevant anatomy, while translated DRRs achieve the best Fréchet inception distance (FID), lung-field sharpness, and agreement with source-CT anatomy among the evaluated methods. Models and inference code: https://huggingface.co/qureaiorg/bone-suppression; Translated projections: https://huggingface.co/datasets/qureaiorg/ct2xr-projections.

</details>


### [218] [GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24981)
*Jiahao Lu,Minghao Yin,Wenbo Hu,Hengyu Liu,Wang Zhao,Sai-Kit Yeung,Ying Shan,Yuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出几何原生自编码器（GAE），将几何基础模型特征重参数化为紧凑潜空间，作为感知与生成的共享基础，显著提升生成视觉质量与3D一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉生成器能生成逼真帧，但无法保持一致的3D场景。作者认为这不仅是建模问题，更是表示问题：生成器多演化以外观为中心的潜变量，而感知模型在语义丰富的空间中恢复几何并编码跨视角结构。

Method: 不将几何作为额外输出，而是把几何基础模型的特征重参数化为用于生成的紧凑潜空间，实现为几何原生自编码器（GAE）。其潜变量可联合解码为外观、深度、相机和点云图。基于该状态，标准条件流支持多样化生成任务。

Result: 在固定生成器与训练协议的受控对比中，用GAE替换潜变量同时提升视觉质量和独立测量的3D一致性：RealEstate10K和DL3DV上FVD分别下降12.7%和23.1%，RealEstate10K上相机轨迹误差减半。

Conclusion: 潜空间是几何一致生成的核心，可作为感知与生成之间的共享接口。

Abstract: We present a compact geometry-native latent space as a shared foundation for perception and generation. Visual generators can produce photorealistic frames without preserving a consistent 3D scene. We argue that this is not only a modeling problem but also a representation problem: generators typically evolve appearance-centric latents, while perception models recover geometry in a semantically rich space that encodes cross-view structure. Rather than adding geometry as another output, we reparameterize a geometry foundation model's features into a compact latent space for generation. We realize this shift with the geometry-native autoencoder (GAE), whose latent is jointly decodable to appearance, depth, cameras, and point maps. With this state, a standard conditional flow supports diverse generation tasks. In controlled comparisons that hold the generator and training protocol fixed, replacing the latent with GAE improves both visual quality and independently measured 3D coherence: FVD falls by $12.7\%$ and $23.1\%$ on RealEstate10K and DL3DV, and camera-trajectory error is halved on RealEstate10K. Together, these results show that the latent space is central to geometry-consistent generation and can serve as a shared interface between perception and generation.

</details>


### [219] [WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24984)
*Wangbo Yu,Kunhao Liu,Wenbo Hu,Shenghai Yuan,Chaoran Feng,Haiyang Zhou,Yukun Huang,Yiran Wang,Wang Zhao,Yingmin Luo,Ying Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldCrafter是一种视频世界模型，通过相机可查询的隐式3D感知记忆，在长时程与跨视角探索中保持与历史观测的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型在长时程和跨视角场景下难以遵守先前观测（一致性差），需要一种能利用历史多视角信息、同时适配生成器有限token预算的记忆机制。

Method: 核心思想是让请求视角决定多视角证据如何压缩进视频生成器的token预算。训练一个记忆编码器与位姿条件读取模块（与视频生成器联合训练），通过记忆编码与位姿条件的读取，将历史观测整合为目标视角特定的固定token集合，无需显式深度对应。结合近期时序上下文与少步蒸馏，实现从单图或文本提示的流式场景探索。

Result: 在静态与动态场景实验中，长时程一致性与相机控制精度显著提升，同时在分钟级探索中保持视觉质量。

Conclusion: WorldCrafter通过视角驱动的隐式3D感知记忆实现了高质量、长时程一致的交互式视频世界探索，支持流式单图/文本生成。

Abstract: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.

</details>


### [220] [VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24997)
*Binxu Li,Haoyi Duan,Yuhui Zhang,Yaohui Zhang,Zihao Lin,Kaituo Feng,Suozhi Huang,Xiangyi Li,Yu Li,Chunyuan Li,Shilong Liu,Mengdi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VideoGen-Agent，一个通过多任务智能体强化学习训练、能调用外部工具的多模态视频生成智能体，并发布VABench基准，性能显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型难以满足需要专业知识、特定身份、物理一致性或有序事件的提示要求。

Method: 通过多轮交互协调增强、生成与验证工具，基于六类任务的类别平衡数据集训练共享策略；先用教师轨迹监督微调建立工具使用行为，再用强化学习优化，并采用类别感知混合奖励评估工具调用有效性、工具选择恰当性和生成视频质量。

Result: 在600条提示的VABench上，较基座文生视频模型提升19.1分（56.5→75.6）；升级生成工具后升至86.1且无需额外训练；人类评分者在84.3%对比中更偏好升级配置。

Conclusion: 验证了跨视频生成任务学习工具使用的有效性，且训练后的智能体可持续受益于生成工具的进步。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events. In this paper, we present VideoGen-Agent, a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. The agent coordinates augmentation, generation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions, using the prompt and intermediate observations to guide its decisions. We train a shared policy on a category-balanced dataset spanning six tasks. Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories establishes tool-use behavior, which is then refined through reinforcement learning. A category-aware hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool use, and generated video quality. We further introduce VABench, a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts covering procedural knowledge, single- and multi-entity identity preservation, physical consistency, scene composition, and multi-shot temporal structure. On VABench, VideoGen-Agent improves over its base text-to-video generator by 19.1 points, from 56.5 to 75.6. Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 without additional agent training. Human raters prefer the upgraded configuration over the strongest standalone baseline in 84.3% of comparisons. These results support learning tool use across video-generation tasks and show that the trained agent can benefit from subsequent advances in generation tools.

</details>


### [221] [GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25001)
*Yiran Wang,Xingyilang Yin,Junfu Pu,Guangzhi Wang,Kaifeng Li,Mingyu Ouyang,Huiqiang Sun,Lingen Li,Cheng Cheng,Wangbo Yu,Honghao Chen,Xiaodong Cun,Chi-Man Pun,Zhiguo Cao,Ying Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GameHorizon套件（标注器、数据集、基准），用5000小时21款3A游戏数据评测47个模型，覆盖多时间尺度的游戏能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频游戏数据集与基准覆盖游戏范围窄、缺少语言指令，或依赖高方差的在线采样，难以标准化衡量AI多时间跨度的游戏能力。

Method: 构建三部分套件：GameHorizon-Annotator自动标注流水线生成多时间跨度指令；GameHorizon-Data（21款游戏、100名专家玩家、5000小时视频+动作+指令）；GameHorizon-Bench含可复现的离线评测与逐步在线测试。

Result: 基于该套件对47个模型进行超百万次调用评测，揭示出明确的任务难度层级及模型能力差异；在线赛道可验证离线分数并定位长程游戏中的失败步骤。

Conclusion: GameHorizon为跨时间跨度与模型家族的游戏能力提供标准化评测标尺，并将开源数据集、标注器与基准以推动未来研究。

Abstract: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons for diverse model families. GameHorizon Suite consists of three components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable and automated annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions. Second, utilizing the pipeline, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It comprises 5,000 hours of recordings from 21 games, collected by 100 human expert players. Third, we build GameHorizon-Bench with reproducible offline and stepwise online testing. The offline track enables reproducible evaluation using thousands of standardized questions organized into three primary tasks and a series of diagnostic variants, while the online track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay capabilities and localizes failures to specific steps within long-horizon gameplay. Based on our GameHorizon Suite, we evaluate 47 models through more than one million model invocations, revealing a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. Our work can provide a standardized yardstick for evaluating gameplay capabilities across horizons and model families. We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [222] [Recognition, Simulation, and Refusal: A Contamination-Aware Study of Classic Psychological Effects in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22090)
*Joy Bose*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 PsyAgentBench，通过因子设计重跑经典心理学实验，区分“产生类人反应模式”与“真正具备该偏见”，揭示不同效应的异质机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 输出类人反应模式不等于其拥有该心理偏见，传统标量偏见分数掩盖了机制差异，需系统区分。

Method: 因子设计：命名/盲测 × 经典/反事实措辞 × 人格操纵，跨五个范式、最多三个开放权重模型，共 41,904 次试验。

Result: 各效应机制迥异：Asch 从众受标签门控（0%→83.3%）；锚定依赖知识信号（事实为0、虚构量近全）；框架效应在标签下放大；沉没成本稳健缺失；最小群体分配受安全拒绝主导。人格改变可消除、削弱或反转效应。

Conclusion: 提出三种迁移失败模式（人格主导、群体坍缩、安全选择），主张用复制档案取代单一偏见分数。

Abstract: An LLM producing the response pattern associated with a human psychological effect is not the same claim as the LLM possessing that bias. We present PsyAgentBench, a benchmark that re-runs classic psychology experiments on LLM agents under a factorial design built to separate these: each paradigm is run with the paradigm explicitly labeled in the prompt (named) or framed as a routine task (blind), and on the literal textbook version of the task (canonical) or a structurally matched variant written to reduce lexical and scenario overlap with likely training data (counterfactual), crossed with a persona manipulation. Across five completed paradigms, evaluated on up to three open-weight model families with 41,904 trials released, apparently human-like effects arise through qualitatively different routes rather than one susceptibility: paradigm-label gating with explicit override (Asch conformity, 0 percent blind to 83.3 percent named on gpt-oss-120B), knowledge-dependent signal reliance (anchoring, exactly zero on grounded facts versus near total on invented quantities, a pattern equally consistent with rational use of the only available signal), amplification on novel content under labeling (framing), robust absence (sunk cost), and safety-mediated selection where refusal itself is the primary finding (minimal-group allocation). A one-sentence persona change (agreeableness, framed as an instruction rather than a verified trait manipulation) eliminates, dampens, or reverses these effects depending on which effect it is, arguing against any single response-bias account. We further formalize, and in two cases document empirically, three ways a psychology paradigm can fail to port to LLM agents: persona dominance, population collapse, and safety selection. We argue scalar bias-susceptibility scores obscure this structure and report replication profiles instead.

</details>


### [223] [Memory That Looks Forward: A Zero-Inference Prospective Term for Personal Memory Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22091)
*Jonathan Groff*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种"前瞻式"记忆检索机制：将用户承诺以显式账本存储，触发时对关联记忆项施加显著性加成，从而在查询时无需推理即可提升检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统记忆检索是回顾式的，只召回与查询相似的内容，无法感知用户已承诺要做的事。需要一种低成本的前瞻性检索能力。

Method: 承诺以带日期或触发条件的条目存入显式账本；当条目触发时，与之关联的记忆项获得显著性加成，并以乘法方式融入基于嵌入的检索，保证相关性仍占主导。

Result: 在仿TriggerBench结构的合成任务集（48个盲写对话、175个任务）上，hard层recall@5从0.000提升至默认权重0.955，floor变体下达1.000；53个已兑现承诺任务零误加成。盲写显示仅17-29%自然表述的承诺-触发对能击败嵌入相似度。

Conclusion: 预计算承诺链接可作为分层设计的常开底层，查询时前瞻为扩展层。结果为初步结论，评测集为作者自建，待TriggerBench数据发布后做正式评测。

Abstract: Retrieval over a personal memory store is retrospective: it surfaces what resembles the query, and it is blind to what the user has committed to do. We describe a prospective term for memory retrieval that costs no inference at query time. Commitments are held in an explicit ledger as dated or trigger-conditioned entries; memory items linked to a firing entry receive a salience boost, blended multiplicatively into embedding-based retrieval so that relevance remains sovereign. On a synthetic prospective-memory task set modeled on TriggerBench's published structure (48 blind-authored dialogues, 175 tasks), the term raised recall@5 on the hard stratum from 0.000 to 0.955 at the default blend weight and to 1.000 under a floor variant, with zero false boosts across 53 resolved-commitment tasks. Blind authorship also produced a scope finding: only 17-29% of naturally phrased commitment-trigger pairs defeat embedding similarity, so the term matters on a real minority of cases and must do no harm on the rest, which it does not. We position precomputed commitment linkage as the always-on floor of a layered design whose expansion layer is query-time prospection. Results are preliminary: the evaluation set is author-constructed, and evaluation on TriggerBench proper is committed follow-up work once its data is released.

</details>


### [224] [SCoR: A Hierarchical Framework for Forecasting Relations Between Scientific Concepts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22174)
*Jingze Wang,Fred Sun,Shangqi Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出层级式科学关系预测框架，构建SCoR-Graph与SCoR-Bench，并开发HiSCoR模型，将研究趋势预测从"共现预测"推进到"关系类型预测"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅预测概念未来共现，但共现只反映共同关注，无法表达科学连接的真实含义（如某方法使用、组合、替代或反驳另一方法），因此需要预测科学关系的形成及其类型。

Method: 将研究方向发现问题形式化为共享候选对空间上的层级关系预测，包含三个时序对齐任务：首次共现、首次科学关系形成、形成时的关系类型。基于187,848篇cs.CV论文构建SCoR-Graph（270,687概念、745万共现边、615,036有类型有向关系边），从截断快照派生防泄漏基准SCoR-Bench（关系类型测试集全部专家验证）。提出HiSCoR模型族，通过编码截断前事件历史并以未来共现为条件，将关系涌现建模为时序演化、层级约束的过程。

Result: 在2025-2026留出窗口上，HiSCoR的AUROC达0.9515，较最强时序图基线相对提升2.4%，population-AUPRC提升14.0%；关系类型变体Macro-AUROC为0.7795。消融实验表明语义、共现与有类型关系三种视图提供互补预测证据。

Conclusion: SCoR将研究方向预测从"哪些概念会共现"推进到"是否有以及如何形成有证据支持的科学关系"。

Abstract: Anticipating emerging research directions is a critical goal of AI-assisted science. Existing methods mainly predict which concepts will co-occur in future papers, but co-occurrence captures shared attention rather than the scientific meaning of a connection, such as whether one method uses, combines, replaces, or contradicts another. We formulate research-direction discovery as hierarchical scientific-relation forecasting over a shared candidate-pair space, comprising three temporally aligned tasks: first co-occurrence, first scientific-relation formation, and relation type at formation. We construct SCoR-Graph from 187,848 cs.CV papers published between 2017 and 2026, yielding 270,687 consolidated concepts, 7.45 million co-occurrence edges, and 615,036 typed, directed relation edges. From cutoff-specific graph snapshots, we derive SCoR-Bench, a leakage-audited benchmark for these three capabilities, with expert-verified gold labels for the entire relation-type test set. We further introduce HiSCoR, a task-adapted model family that models relation emergence as a temporally evolving, hierarchically constrained process by encoding pre-cutoff event histories and conditioning relation formation on future co-occurrence. On the held-out 2025-2026 window, HiSCoR achieves an AUROC of 0.9515, a 2.4% relative improvement over the strongest temporal-graph baseline, and improves population-AUPRC by 14.0%; its relation-type variant achieves a Macro-AUROC of 0.7795. Ablations show that semantic, co-occurrence, and typed-relation views provide complementary predictive evidence. SCoR advances research-direction forecasting from predicting which concepts will co-occur to anticipating whether and how evidence-backed scientific relations will emerge.

</details>


### [225] [Summarize, Judge, Refine: Decoupled Content Understanding and Policy Learning for Multimodal Content Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22094)
*Zeeshan Ahmed,Yang Qin,Hanqing Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SJR双模型架构，通过自然语言接口解耦多模态理解与策略分类，实现策略无关的可解释内容审核与少样本策略启动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统内容审核将多模态理解与特定策略分类耦合，策略变更需全流程重训；且多模态数据难以有效增强，导致标签稀缺问题严重。

Method: SJR包含两个模型：多模态Content Model生成结构化文本摘要，纯文本Policy Model据策略定义对摘要分类。通过迭代协同训练循环用GRPO优化Content Model以生成策略相关摘要；并利用文本空间增强生成对抗性摘要变体，实现少样本策略引导。

Result: 在误导性广告检测上，SJR相较零样本思维链基线实现+23.6%相对非误导F1提升，优于端到端SFT、STaR/RFT与RLFT。仅用合成正类数据（零真实违规样本）训练的变体在违规F1上与全数据模型相对差距仅0.2%。

Conclusion: 解耦式架构使策略变更无需重训全流程，且可在无真实违规数据下启动新策略；基于人类可读摘要的决策天然具备可解释性。

Abstract: Content moderation systems traditionally entangle multimodal understanding with policy-specific classification, requiring full pipeline retraining for every policy change and suffering from label scarcity since multimedia cannot be meaningfully augmented. We propose Summarize-Judge-Refine (SJR), a two-model architecture that decouples these concerns via a natural language interface: a multimodal Content Model produces structured text summaries, and a text-only Policy Model classifies them against policy definitions. An iterative co-training loop refines the Content Model via GRPO to produce policy-relevant summaries, while text-space augmentation generates adversarial summary variants---an augmentation pathway impossible on raw multimedia---enabling few-shot policy bootstrap. Every decision is grounded in a human-readable summary, providing interpretability as a structural byproduct. On misleading advertisement detection, SJR achieves +23.6\% relative non-misleading F1 over a zero-shot chain-of-thought baseline, outperforming end-to-end SFT, STaR/RFT, and RLFT. Notably, a variant trained on zero real violating examples---with all positive-class data synthetically generated---matches the full-data model within 0.2\% relative on violating F1, demonstrating that new policies can launch without any real violation data.

</details>


### [226] [The Role of AI in Online Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22198)
*Valeria Lerman,Oren Rigbi,Yaniv Dover*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出利用LLM供给冲击（模型价格与能力的突变）对比认证与非认证评论，来识别生成式AI对平台活动的影响。应用于Trustpilot超1300万条评论发现：LLM供给冲击后，非认证评论更趋负面；效应主要由新模型发布驱动，集中在评论量最低和最高的企业。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的快速普及为平台上的策略性内容生成带来机会，包括可能损害平台有效性的操纵行为；但AI生成内容难以直接观测，导致此类活动难以测量。

Method: 利用离散的LLM供给冲击（模型价格与能力的突变），对比认证与非认证评论，识别与生成式AI供给改善相关的平台活动变化；应用于Trustpilot超1300万条评论。

Result: 稳健发现：LLM供给冲击后，非认证评论转向更负面——更多1星、更少5星、评分更低；效应主要由新模型发布驱动，集中在评论量最低和最高的企业。此外，供给冲击引发短促而集中的评论活动爆发。

Conclusion: 生成式AI已在重塑在线平台上的声誉与竞争运作方式，策略性AI使用可能改变平台竞争动态。

Abstract: The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) creates new opportunities for strategic content generation on online platforms, including potentially harmful forms of manipulation that may undermine platform effectiveness and reshape platform dynamics. However, measuring such activity is difficult because AI-generated content is rarely directly observable. We introduce an empirical approach that leverages discrete LLM supply shocks - abrupt changes in model prices and capabilities, and contrasts verified with non-verified reviews to identify changes in platform activity associated with generative AI supply improvements. We apply this approach to more than 13 million reviews from Trustpilot, one of the leading online platforms for business reviews. A robust finding is that following LLM supply shocks, unverified reviews shift toward greater negativity: more 1-stars, fewer 5-stars, and lower ratings, with effects driven primarily by new model releases and concentrated among firms with the lowest and highest review volumes, suggesting that strategic AI use may reshape platform competition dynamics. We further find that LLM supply shocks trigger short, concentrated bursts of review activity. Together, these findings suggest that generative AI is already reshaping how reputation and competition operate on online platforms.

</details>


### [227] [AI-inferred expressed well-being and collective-action discourse in climate-change campaigns on X](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22096)
*Wentao Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究分析19个发生年份中四个气候活动（地球日、地球一小时、全球气候行动日、世界环境日）的364,118条Twitter/X帖子，发现活动期幸福感语言显著上升，但行动语言下降，呈"幸福—行动背离"，且更幸福的原帖被转发的概率更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有气候运动研究多关注注意力与动员，较少考察伴随的福祉语言。活动期是否改变积极情感与希望、幸福感是否与行动语言一致，尚不清楚。

Method: 收集四个气候活动在19个发生年份的364,118条公开Twitter/X帖子，划分活动前30天、活动期、活动后窗口；采用带版本控制的加权词汇模型估计幸福感、未来导向希望、集体能力、痛苦与行动语言；并进行构成稳健性检查、文本去重检验，以及19簇wild bootstrap估计精度；同时分析原帖幸福度与匹配转推级联的关系。

Result: 活动期幸福感占比比活动前基线高9.02个百分点；配对发生对比显示行动语言下降10.75个百分点，呈现幸福—行动背离。幸福感估计在构成与去重检验下仍为正，但在19簇wild bootstrap下精度较低；更幸福的原帖出现匹配转推级联的几率更低。

Conclusion: 气候活动期伴随幸福感语言上升但行动语言下降，二者存在背离，且幸福表达与传播扩散呈负相关；提示仅以注意力或情感指标评估气候运动可能掩盖行动层面的不足。

Abstract: Climate campaigns are often evaluated through attention and mobilization, but less is known about the well-being language that accompanies them. Whether campaign periods alter positive affect and hope, and whether happiness aligns with action language, remains unresolved. We analysed 364,118 public Twitter/X posts from Earth Day, Earth Hour, Global Climate Action Day and World Environment Day in 19 occurrence-years, using 30-day pre-event, event and post-event windows. A versioned weighted lexical model estimated happiness, future-oriented hope, collective capability, distress and action language. Event-period happiness prevalence was 9.02 percentage points higher than the pre-event baseline , whereas paired occurrence contrasts showed a 10.75-point decline in action language, indicating a happiness--action divergence. The happiness estimate remained positive across composition and text-deduplication checks, but was less precise under a 19-cluster wild bootstrap. Happier source posts had lower odds of an observed matched retweet cascade.

</details>


### [228] [Token Signatures of Code: Comparing Coding Behaviors Across Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22097)
*Junpeng Wang,Yuzhong Chen,Menghai Pan,Uday Singh Saini,Yiwei Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CLIC，一种通过token频率分析与可解释决策树来刻画LLM编码行为的可视分析方法，定义鲁棒性和集中度两个新指标，并构建交互式可视分析系统支持多尺度对比探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM编码任务评估主要依赖pass@k等性能指标，随着模型性能趋同，这些指标的区分能力下降，而LLM在编码行为上的差异这一关键问题尚未被充分探索。

Method: CLIC将每个代码样本表示为token频率特征向量，训练可解释决策树以区分两个LLM的代码集；定义鲁棒性（逐步移除最具区分性token后模型是否仍可区分）和集中度（差异是否由少数主导token驱动）两个指标；开发交互式可视分析系统，支持跨LLM对、任务与分词层级的多尺度假设驱动探索与下钻。

Result: 在22个Kaggle ML任务上对10个LLM进行案例研究，揭示了对模型选择与提示工程有实际价值的洞察。

Conclusion: CLIC通过token频率分析与交互式可视化补充了传统性能评估，为理解和比较LLM编码行为提供了新视角与可操作洞察。

Abstract: The evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on coding tasks has primarily focused on performance metrics such as pass@k. As LLMs continue to advance, many models now meet baseline performance requirements, reducing the discriminative power of performance-based evaluation alone. Yet a key question remains largely unexplored: how do LLMs differ in their coding behavior? We propose CLIC (Code Learning for Identification and Comparison), a visual analytics approach that characterizes LLM coding behavior through token-frequency analysis. CLIC represents each code sample as a feature vector of token frequencies and trains an interpretable decision tree to separate two LLMs' code sets. Beyond classification accuracy, we define two new metrics: robustness, which measures whether the two LLMs remain distinguishable as their most-discriminative tokens are progressively removed, and concentration, which measures whether the difference is driven by a few dominant tokens or spread across many. Interpreting numerous pairwise comparisons (across LLM pairs, tasks, and tokenization levels) and tracing the full analytical chain form an inherently multi-scale, hypothesis-driven exploration task. We therefore develop an interactive visual analytics system to navigate the comparison landscape, identify pairs of interest, and drill down into discriminative tokens and their code contexts. Case studies comparing 10 LLMs across 22 Kaggle ML tasks reveal actionable insights for LLM selection and prompt engineering.

</details>


### [229] [TreeSpark: Calibrated, Load-Adaptive Draft Trees for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22098)
*Huapeng Zhou,Huayu Wang,Xinyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TreeSpark 提出基于路径存活率(parent-conditioned)的推测解码树构建方法，实现自适应树预算和负载感知服务策略，加速 LLM 推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有块级 drafter 使草拟几乎免费，但推测树构建存在两个问题：(1) 用忽略父节点的逐位置边缘分布排序候选，导致半自回归 drafter 上更宽的树只增加错误排序节点；(2) 固定大小的树忽略了每轮解码和服务负载可支持的推测量。

Method: 从 drafter 已有的 Markov head 以极小开销读取父条件分布，校准为边接受率估计；用路径存活率驱动最优优先扩展、每轮停止和负载自适应服务策略。无放回采样兄弟节点，并在递归拒绝采样中匹配残差，保证任意温度下无损解码。
