With correct interpretation on all evaluated contracts, Jev reduces median decision latency by 22.4% against DeepSeek and 61.9% against Gemini; completion in the modeled update scenarios rises by 3.50 and 8.35 percentage points. A separate comparison with direct-attribute Qwen retains a 53.0% latency reduction and a 4.78-point completion gain. Exchanging recorded model and scheduling waits reproduces the comparator completion summaries for all 12 trajectories in each of two modeled comparisons. In the real image service, Jev retains faster decisions and completes 459 requests correctly and on time, compared with 463 for DeepSeek and 435 for Qwen out of 1,080 each. These findings connect fast intent decisions to timely edge service execution and support using Jev at contract activation, with numerical scheduling adapting placements to current network and computing state.

</details>


### [409] [Orientation-Aware Control and Trajectory Design for Aerial RIS-Assisted Wireless Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23157)
*Abdoul Karim A. H. Saliah,Hajar El Hammouti,Daniel Bonilla Licea,Giuseppe Silano*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出方向感知的ARIS框架，显式建模无人机动力学与方向相关信道，联合通信与控制设计提升吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ARIS部署中RIS刚性安装于多旋翼无人机，产生位置-方向耦合动力学；RIS性能对方向高度敏感，点质量或方向不变模型会给出过于乐观的性能估计。

Method: 结合通信引导的参考轨迹规划器与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）实现动态可行的轨迹跟踪与有利的RIS朝向，并采用轻量级波束成形与RIS相移更新。

Result: 考虑方向使用户吞吐量提升13.77%；联合通信更新相比仅相移优化提升网络吞吐量28%，相比仅波束成形优化至少提升2.5倍。

Conclusion: 方向感知建模与通信-控制联合设计在ARIS辅助无线系统中至关重要。

Abstract: Aerial Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (ARISs) can enhance wireless connectivity in obstructed environments by combining reconfigurable metasurfaces with aerial mobility. However, in practical deployments, the Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) is rigidly mounted on a multi-rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), which creates coupled position-orientation dynamics that directly affect communication quality. Since RIS performance is highly sensitive to orientation, point-mass or orientation-invariant models may lead to optimistic performance estimates. This paper proposes an orientation-aware ARIS framework that explicitly accounts for UAV dynamics, actuation limits, and orientation-dependent channels. The proposed approach combines a communications-guided reference trajectory planner with a Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for dynamically feasible trajectory tracking and favorable RIS orientation, while employing lightweight beamforming and RIS phase-shift updates. Simulations show that accounting for orientation improves user throughput by 13.77%, while the proposed joint communication updates improve network throughput by 28% over phase-shift-only optimization and by at least a factor of 2.5 over beamforming-only optimization. These results highlight the importance of orientation-aware modeling and joint communication-control design in ARIS-assisted wireless systems.

</details>


### [410] [Protocol-Flexible Custom NFC for Wire-Free Wearable Sensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23347)
*Riku Maeda,Akihito Noda*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出一种软件定义协议的定制NFC系统，用于分布式可穿戴传感器通信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统有线方案受机械约束影响可穿戴性，蓝牙等无线方案则受身体引起的信号衰减和覆盖范围限制。

Method: 系统兼容织物集成的蜿蜒线圈，由微控制器与紧凑的调制解调电路组成，MAC及其他通信协议以软件方式实现。

Result: 实验实现从三个传感器标签持续采集三轴加速度数据，单标签轮询率222 Hz，有效吞吐约16 kbps，误包率30%下每标签每秒获得156个有效样本。

Conclusion: 该系统为面向服装尺度的NFC通信提供可行路径，可用于身体分布式可穿戴传感器的持续数据采集。

Abstract: This study presents a custom near-field communication (NFC) system with software-defined protocol implementation for wearable sensors distributed across the body. Conventional wired implementations can degrade wearability because of mechanical constraints, whereas radio-based wireless approaches such as Bluetooth are affected by body-induced signal attenuation and limited communication coverage. The proposed system is compatible with previously demonstrated fabric-integrated meander coils, which provides a feasible path toward garment-scale NFC communication areas. The system combines a microcontroller unit with compact modulation and demodulation circuits, allowing medium access control and other communication protocols to be implemented in software. Experimental results demonstrate continuous acquisition of three-axis acceleration data from three sensor tags, achieving a per-tag polling rate of $222\,\mathrm{Hz}$ and an effective throughput of approximately $16\,\mathrm{kbps}$, delivering $156$ valid samples per second per tag at a measured packet error rate of $30\%$.

</details>


### [411] [SemDHT: Certified Semantic Discovery for Peer-to-Peer Agent Networks over Exact-Key DHTs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23539)
*Taotao Wang,Chonghe Zhao,Shengli Zhang,Soung Chang Liew*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: SemDHT 是一种在精确键 DHT 上实现智能体能力语义发现的可认证语义索引，在保证召回率的同时显著降低查找次数与发布扇出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 请求方未绑定提供方时需发现匹配任务与接口要求的能力；精确键 DHT 上广泛检索会传输大量候选，选择检索又会漏掉相关提供方或需要更多复制和查找，且开放发布使提供方可能虚增曝光。

Method: 采用两层语义草图（粗粒度单元分组邻近描述符，残差码细化候选）；提供方在一组有限的派生键上发布，请求方在查找预算内先探测精度键再探测宽召回键；锚点委员会认证每个描述符的发布键集合，使存储服务和请求方能强制描述符到键的一致性。

Result: 在真实 API 描述符和任务查询上，recall@10 对精确嵌入空间邻居达 0.955，对 ToolBench 相关性标签达 0.947；在受控密度增强语料上，recall 0.95 时查找次数比调优 LSH 少 7.7 倍，发布扇出从 16 降至 10；Go/libp2p 原型在 200 节点云覆盖上重放 299 条互联网查询，并行探测与冷证书缓存下平均完成时间分别为 LSH 的 3.64 倍和 4.11 倍加速。

Conclusion: SemDHT 通过可认证的两层语义索引，在精确键 DHT 上实现了高效、可验证的智能体能力发现，兼顾召回率、查找效率和发布受限性。

Abstract: Agents may need capabilities exposed through external agent endpoints or service APIs. When a requester is not already bound to a provider, it must discover advertised capabilities matching its task and interface requirements. Over exact-key distributed hash tables (DHTs), broad retrieval transfers large candidate lists, whereas selective retrieval may miss relevant providers or require more replication and lookups. Open publication also lets providers inflate their exposure unless publication bounds are enforceable. We present SemDHT, a certified semantic index for discovering agent-accessible capabilities over exact-key DHTs. A two-layer semantic sketch uses coarse cells to group nearby descriptors and residual codes to narrow candidate selection. Providers publish at a bounded set of derived keys, while requesters probe precision keys before broader recall keys within a lookup budget. Anchor committees certify each descriptor's publication-key set, enabling storage services and requesters to enforce descriptor-to-key consistency. On real API descriptors and task queries, SemDHT achieves recall@10 of 0.955 against exact embedding-space neighbors and 0.947 against ToolBench relevance labels. On a corpus with controlled density augmentation, it matches the candidate exposure of tuned locality-sensitive hashing (LSH) over a DHT at recall 0.95 with 7.7x fewer lookups and reduces publication fan-out from 16 to 10. A Go/libp2p prototype deployed on same-region and cross-region 200-peer cloud overlays replays 299 Internet queries. With parallel probes and cold certificate caches, SemDHT achieves mean completion-time speedups of 3.64x and 4.11x over LSH, respectively.

</details>


### [412] [Zero-Knowledge Remote Adversarial Attack against Wi-Fi-based Human Activity Recognition for Privacy Protection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24173)
*Byungjun Kim,Amogh Panchagatti,Peter Gerstoft,Xinyu Zhang,Minsung Kim*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: GRAW是一种"以攻为守"的隐私防御系统，通过扰动路由器信号、利用GAIL生成扰动信号，在无需目标HAR模型任何信息（零知识）的情况下，将人体活动识别性能降至随机猜测水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wi-Fi设备借助CSI识别人体活动的能力日益增强，带来了隐私泄露风险，而现有防御手段需要额外代价，因此需要一种能保护用户隐私的方法。

Method: GRAW作为对抗方系统充当隐私防御者，在用户设备端扰动路由器信号，使用户估计的CSI失真。其采用生成对抗模仿学习（GAIL）构建扰动信号，实现对目标HAR系统及其输入的零知识操作。

Result: 在七个代表性HAR模型、五个环境（含自建数据集）上评估：GRAW是唯一能将所有测试HAR模型降至随机选择水平的远程攻击方案；相同扰动水平下攻击成功率比对比方法高最多76.7%，同时保持超99%的Wi-Fi包成功率；并通过软件无线电实时空口实验验证可行性。

Conclusion: GRAW表明零知识的远程信号扰动可有效防御基于CSI的人体活动识别，兼具高攻击效果与低通信干扰，具备实际可行性。

Abstract: The growing capability of Wi-Fi devices to identify human activities using channel state information (CSI) raises privacy concerns. To counter this threat, we propose GRAW, an adversary system, acting as a privacy defender, that degrades the human activity recognition (HAR) system at the user device by perturbing the router's signals that the device uses to estimate CSI. GRAW employs generative adversarial imitation learning (GAIL) to construct perturbation signals, and thereby eliminates the need for any information on the target HAR systems and their inputs (i.e., zero-knowledge operation). We evaluate GRAW against seven representative HAR models, using datasets collected in five environments, including our own dataset. We observe that GRAW is the only remote attack scheme that degrades every tested HAR model to a random-selection level. At the same perturbation level, GRAW achieves an attack success ratio up to 76.7% higher than comparison methods, while maintaining over 99% packet success rate on regular Wi-Fi communication. We demonstrate the feasibility of GRAW through real-time, over-the-air experiments with software-defined radios.

</details>


### [413] [Joint Energy Efficiency and Fairness Optimization for D2D Communications in Aerial-Ground Integrated Heterogeneous Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24365)
*Chuan-Chi Lai,Ang-Hsun Tsai,Shang-Long Wu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出空天地一体化异构网络(AGIHN)架构下低复杂度多信道速率公平(MCRF)算法，支持D2D共享复用，并结合干扰避免策略，联合优化吞吐量、公平性与能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宏蜂窝用户上行接入需求增长，需借助无人机空中基站增强覆盖；多D2D对的上行资源分配复杂，传统独占分配频谱效率低，非正交共享又带来严重层内干扰。

Method: 构建由地面宏基站与UAV空中基站组成的AGIHN架构；提出低复杂度MCRF算法，允许多D2D对在同一资源块共享复用；引入启发式干扰避免(IA)策略抑制层内干扰；无需离线训练即可联合优化吞吐量、公平性与能效。

Result: 相较单信道独占复用方案，MCRF使D2D能效与吞吐量分别提升约397%和542%；相比多信道基准(如MCRR)，公平性指数提升7.43%，在强干扰环境下仍保持超过0.6的公平性得分。

Conclusion: MCRF在共享复用模式下显著提升频谱效率与能效，并在效率与公平之间取得更优权衡，验证了AGIHN中低复杂度资源分配方案的有效性。

Abstract: This study investigates an Aerial-Ground Integrated Heterogeneous network (AGIHN) architecture that combines terrestrial macro base stations and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) serving as aerial base stations to enhance uplink access for macrocell users. To address the complex uplink resource allocation challenge for multiple device-to-device (D2D) communication pairs, we propose a low-complexity Multi-Channel Rate-Fair (MCRF) algorithm. Distinct from traditional exclusive allocation methods, MCRF supports shared reuse, enabling multiple D2D pairs to simultaneously multiplex on the same resource block, thereby significantly improving spectral efficiency. To manage the severe intra-tier interference arising from this non-orthogonal sharing, a heuristic Interference Avoidance (IA) strategy is integrated to ensure the transmission quality of D2D users. The proposed framework jointly optimizes system throughput, user fairness, and energy efficiency without requiring computationally intensive offline training. Simulation results demonstrate distinct performance advantages depending on the reuse mode: Compared to traditional single-channel exclusive reuse schemes, MCRF achieves massive gains, increasing D2D energy efficiency and throughput by approximately 397% and 542%, respectively. Furthermore, relative to multi-channel benchmarks (e.g., MCRR), the proposed algorithm optimizes the efficiency-fairness trade-off, enhancing the fairness index by 7.43% while maintaining a robust fairness score exceeding 0.6 in interference-prone environments.

</details>


### [414] [ALARM: Adaptive Layer-Aware Resource Management for Power-Efficient vRANs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24765)
*Ali Srour,Farzad Veisi,Sami Taktak,Vania Conan*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: ALARM：面向受限5G vRAN的分层感知自适应资源管理框架，按协议层粒度控制CPU资源以降低功耗并保持实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: vRAN支持细粒度CPU资源管理以实现动态功耗控制，但现有方法将gNB视为单体，忽略了不同协议层的异构计算特性，导致过度供给。

Method: 将gNB分解为功能层，基于处理权重在层级别控制CPU资源；监控每层性能以检测违规，仅对受影响层进行扩展。

Result: 在两个受限平台上，功耗较未优化基线降低最多33%，较均匀缩放方法降低19%；动态自适应额外节省9.8%，同时保持严格实时保证。

Conclusion: 分层感知的定向自适应资源管理可显著降低vRAN功耗，避免传统均匀缩放的过度供给，并满足实时约束。

Abstract: The transition to virtualized Radio Access Networks (vRAN) enables dynamic power control through fine-grained CPU resource management. However, existing approaches treat gNB as a monolithic entity, failing to exploit the heterogeneous computational characteristics of different protocol layers. This paper proposes ALARM, a layer-aware adaptive resource management framework for constrained 5G vRAN. ALARM decomposes the gNB into functional layers representing distinct RAN tasks with heterogeneous computational demands, and controls CPU resources at the layer level based on processing weights. The framework monitors per-layer performance to detect violations and responds by scaling only the affected layer. This targeted adaptation avoids the over-provisioning inherent in traditional uniform scaling approaches. Experimental validation on two constrained platforms demonstrates up to 33% power reduction versus non-optimized baseline and 19% beyond uniform approaches, with dynamic adaptation achieving 9.8% additional savings while preserving strict real-time guarantees.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [415] [When Who You Are Can Change the Code You Get: A Study of Persona-Induced Bias in LLM Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22102)
*Anubhav Gupta,Mayara Costa Figueiredo,Leticia Santos Machado,Tanner Wright,Ivan Beschastnikh,Cleidson R. B. de Souza,Gema Rodríguez-Pérez*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文大规模实证研究LLM代码生成中的"人设诱导偏见"，发现用户人口统计信息（国籍、性别、经验）会渗入模型推理与输出，并对代码质量产生跨模型的显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM广泛用作编程助手，但用户人口统计信息是否以及如何影响生成代码的技术质量尚不清楚。作者希望揭示LLM辅助软件开发中被忽视的偏见风险。

Method: 在18种人口统计人设（国籍、性别、经验水平）下，与中性基线对比，研究Gemini 2.5 Pro和GPT-OSS-120B两个模型。分析35,000+生成程序，考察推理与响应中的人口统计标记泄漏，以及功能正确性、可维护性、代码风格与安全性差异。

Result: 人口统计标记常出现在推理与输出中（响应最高65%，推理链最高70%）。LiveCodeBench上，Gemini人设提示使正确率平均下降1.54个百分点，某一人设下降3.6%（OR=0.51）；GPT-OSS反而提升3.4–5.7%（OR=1.8–3.0）。可维护性与代码风格效应显著但极小（Cliff's δ<0.15），安全漏洞无系统性人设模式。

Conclusion: 即使在纯技术任务中，用户人口统计信息也与LLM推理和代码质量的可测量变化相关，且跨模型成立，凸显了LLM辅助软件开发中被忽视的风险。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used as programming assistants, yet it remains unclear whether and how user's demographic information impacts the technical quality of generated code. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of persona-induced bias in LLM-based code generation, focusing a proprietary model (Gemini 2.5 Pro) and an open-weight model (GPT-OSS-120B). Using 18 demographic personas spanning nationality, gender, and experience level, we compare persona-induced prompts against a neutral baseline. Across 35,000+ generated programs, we analyze demographic marker leakage in reasoning and responses, as well as differences in functional correctness, maintainability, code style, and security.
  Our results show that demographic cues are frequently reflected in LLM reasoning and outputs. Demographic markers appear in up to 65% of responses and 70% of reasoning traces, despite being semantically irrelevant to the tasks. On LiveCodeBench, persona prompting were associated with lower correctness scores of the Gemini model by an average of 1.54 percentage points, with one persona exhibiting a decrease of 3.6% (odds ratio = 0.51). In contrast, the accuracy of the GPT-OSS model improved by 3.4 - 5.7% across all personas (odds ratios = 1.8 - 3.0). Maintainability and code style metrics show statistically significant but negligible effect sizes (all Cliff's δ < 0.15), and security vulnerabilities exhibit no systematic persona-specific patterns.
  Overall, our results show that the presence of demographic information about users is associated with measurable variation in LLM reasoning and code quality even in purely technical tasks, and that these effects hold across models. Our work highlights an under-examined risk in LLM-assisted software development.

</details>


### [416] [A Governance-Aware Large Language Model Orchestrated Agentic Digital Twin for Transmission System Operator Control Room Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22476)
*Costas Mylonas,Magda Foti,Emmanouel Varvarigos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"治理感知"的智能体数字孪生框架，用于输电控制室，让LLM仅负责选择与参数化白名单分析工具，所有动作必须通过不可绕过的治理层，四规则在多项基准上无一例外成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源并网、惯量下降与安全裕度收紧使输电系统运行复杂度上升；LLM虽可提供自然语言决策支持，但其幻觉、不受控的工具使用和弱可追溯性与控制室要求相冲突。

Method: 构建治理感知的智能体数字孪生：LLM只选择并参数化白名单工具；治理层对每次运行强制四条规则——仅白名单工具可执行、不超步数预算、有副作用的动作须操作员明确批准、答案中每个数字由治理层基于后端结果渲染并附带单位/变量/时间；规则在持久审计轨迹上校验。

Result: 在希腊输电网数字孪生的118任务基准上，主模型590次运行中工具选择率96.5%、任务成功率93.7%，四条规则无一例外成立；跨4个LLM、3次重复共1416次运行，规则全部成立，约95%置信下界为99.8%；移除治理层后，45个需批准运行全部被擅自执行，仅39.2%答案含后端支持数字；强制治理开销为每请求12–16毫秒。

Conclusion: 治理层可在低开销下有效约束LLM的工具使用与输出可信度，满足控制室对可追溯性与安全性的要求，是LLM用于电网调度的可行安全架构。

Abstract: Transmission system operators face rising complexity from renewable integration, reduced inertia, and tighter security margins. Large language models offer natural-language decision support, but their hallucinations, uncontrolled tool use, and weak traceability conflict with control room requirements. This paper presents a governance-aware agentic digital twin for transmission grid control rooms. The large language model only selects and parameterizes whitelisted analysis tools, and every proposed action passes through a governance layer that the model cannot bypass. The layer enforces four rules on every run. Only whitelisted tools execute. No run exceeds its step budget. No action with side effects executes without explicit operator approval. Every number in an answer is rendered by the layer from backend results with its unit, variable, and time. The rules are checked on a persistent audit trail for every run of a released 118-task benchmark, which covers analytics, simulation, multi-step workflows, and twelve families of adversarial inputs on a digital twin of the Greek transmission network. Across 590 runs of the primary model, tool selection reaches 96.5% and task success 93.7%, and all four rules hold without exception. In a separate three-repetition study across four large language models, 1416 runs in total, the rules again hold on every run, with an approximate 95% lower bound of 99.8%. Removing the layer makes the same model execute all 45 approval-requiring runs without authorization and leaves only 39.2% of its answers with backend-supported numbers. Enforcement costs 12 to 16 milliseconds per request.

</details>


### [417] [Identity or Prompt Noise? A Calibrated Invariance Audit of LLM Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22511)
*Maksim E. Eren,Ryan Barron,Eric Michalak,Charles Nicholas,Manish Bhattarai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 审计3073万份Python生成，发现职业人格对代码形式有小而可复现的影响，但无稳定劣势或下游危害证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身份线索与固定编程规范无关，但原始反事实差异可能源于样本不均与提示措辞，需澄清身份偏见是否真实存在。

Method: 在HumanEval+/MBPP+上对7个检查点的3073万执行生成进行审计，辅以550B探索切片；施加模型分配性别、国家、职业人格；采用任务内随机化与FDR控制。

Result: 职业是最一致的结构轴：CodeBLEU离散度在10/14单元超交换零假设，8/12全覆盖单元显著，均超国家；6个高通过率单元中职业离散度在多种指标复现，但通过率离散度均不显著；国家原始离散度高但校准比中位数1.00；性别无法与措辞分离。

Conclusion: 证据支持职业条件下的代码形式小型可复现变化，而非对特定身份稳定劣势或下游危害；据此讨论代码生成偏见影响及模型可能依据对话上下文身份信息调节输出。

Abstract: Identity cues are irrelevant to a fixed programming specification, but raw counterfactual differences can arise from unequal samples and prompt wording. We audit 30.73 million executed Python generations from seven checkpoints on HumanEval+ and MBPP+, supplemented by an exploratory 550B slice, under model-assigned gender, country, and occupation personas. Within-task randomization and false-discovery-rate control identify occupation as the most consistent structural axis: CodeBLEU dispersion exceeds its exchangeability null in 10/14 model--benchmark cells, remains significant in 8/12 full-coverage cells, and exceeds the country ratio in every paired cell, although the median excess is only 0.141 points. In six high-pass-rate cells, occupation dispersion replicates across token similarity, length, comments, reference similarity, and complexity, while pass-rate dispersion is significant in none. Country leads raw dispersion in 12/14 cells but has a median calibrated ratio of 1.00. Gender-associated variation cannot be separated from persona wording in this design. Thus, the evidence supports small, reproducible occupation-conditioned changes in code form, not stable disadvantage to named identities or demonstrated downstream harm. We use this finding to motivate a broader commentary on the potential impacts of bias in code generation, including the possibility that models may condition their outputs on identity information available from prior conversational context.

</details>


### [418] [Does Order Matter? An Empirical Investigation into the Impact of File Ordering on Code Review Effectiveness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22610)
*Md Shamimur Rahman,Zadia Codabux,Chanchal K. Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 大规模研究(33万PR、18.2万项目)表明文件排序等结构性因素影响代码评审注意力分配，存在"注意力-有效性缺口"，提出上下文感知排序等建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码评审质量依赖评审者专业度、变更特征及工具呈现方式，但多数平台默认按字母排序文件，与开发者理解多文件PR的认知方式不符；这种排序对结果的大规模影响尚不明确。

Method: 从5种编程语言的182个GitHub项目挖掘330,343个多文件PR和756,814个文件实例，分析文件位置与后续修复变更的关联、PR规模的调节作用，以及以评论为代表的评审注意力是否与潜在缺陷一致；采用hurdle模型建模。

Result: 文件位置、PR规模、评审活动与潜在缺陷率存在统计显著但较弱的关联。潜在缺陷率从位置1的56.7%升至位置30的61.5%；PR规模与缺陷率呈非线性关系(约10个文件风险最低)；每增加一个修改文件，获得任何评论的几率下降约8.7%。

Conclusion: 字母排序并非中立的界面默认，而是塑造注意力分配、评审覆盖与结果信心的结构性特征；可见的评审活动未必能防止缺陷。提出上下文感知排序、依赖感知分组、风险感知优先级及逐文件覆盖指标等改进建议。

Abstract: Modern code review is central to software quality, but its effectiveness depends on reviewer expertise, change characteristics, and how tools present changes. Most platforms display modified files alphabetically by default, although our prior work shows that developers find this ordering cognitively misaligned with how they understand multi-file pull requests. Whether these ordering-related attention patterns affect outcomes at scale remains unclear. We present a large-scale study of file ordering and review effectiveness, mining 330,343 multi-file pull requests and 756,814 file instances from 182 GitHub projects in five programming languages. We examine whether file position is associated with later bug-fixing changes, whether pull request size moderates this relationship, and whether reviewer attention, proxied by comments, aligns with latent bug outcomes. Results show statistically significant but modest associations among file position, pull request size, review activity, and latent bug likelihood. Latent bug rates rise from 56.7% at position 1 to 61.5% at position 30. Pull request size has a non-linear relationship with latent bug likelihood: pull requests of about ten files have the lowest risk, while very small and very large ones have elevated rates. Hurdle models show that attention is diluted as pull request size grows: each additional modified file reduces the odds of receiving any review comment by about 8.7%. These findings reveal an attention-effectiveness gap: visible review activity does not necessarily prevent defects. Alphabetical ordering is therefore not a neutral interface default, but a structural feature shaping attention allocation, review coverage, and confidence in review outcomes. We propose context-aware file ordering, dependency-aware grouping, risk-aware prioritization, and per-file coverage indicators to make review attention more visible and actionable.

</details>


### [419] [Why Do Pull Requests Go Silent? Uncovering the Barriers to Contribution Completion in Open-Source Code Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22625)
*Md Shamimur Rahman,Farhana Akter,Md Mustakim Billah,Zadia Codabux,Chanchal K. Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文分析 GitHub 上 19 个仓库中 14,234 个停滞 PR 及 164,562 条评论，揭示 PR 停滞的贡献类型、讨论层面障碍及后续协作影响，并提出改进建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PR 常因未集成而停滞并被放弃，浪费贡献者与维护者精力。既有研究多关注 PR 放弃与评审延迟，但对停滞相关的贡献类型、讨论层面障碍及停滞后的协作模式了解不足。

Method: 分析 19 个流行 GitHub 仓库的 14,234 个停滞 PR 与 164,562 条评审评论；用基于 LLM 的投票分类器按贡献类型分类 PR，并结合定量分析与对一般评论和行内讨论的定性编码。仓库采用 stale-bot 工作流。

Result: 功能增强与问题修复类 PR 占比最大，合计超过分类停滞 PR 的 77%。一般评论显示停滞主要源于沟通与协调失灵（缺少互动、反馈延迟、跟进不清）。行内评论表明停滞不总等于脱离：许多 PR 被技术或依赖问题阻塞，如检查失败、配置问题、兼容性顾虑和环境不匹配。仅 39.56% 的贡献者后来再提交 PR，评审者对同一贡献者的再参与约 21%。

Conclusion: PR 停滞是涉及沟通、技术就绪、评审责任归属与自动化实践的社会技术协调问题。建议类型感知分流、更清晰评审反馈、明确下一步行动责任人、CI 阻塞管理及原因感知的 stale-bot 干预。

Abstract: Pull requests (PRs) underpin pull-based software development by enabling distributed code review and collaborative contribution in open-source projects. Yet many become inactive before integration and are eventually abandoned or closed, wasting contributor and maintainer effort. Although prior work has examined PR abandonment and review delays, less is known about the contribution types, discussion-level barriers, and post-stalling collaboration patterns associated with inactivity. We investigate which PR types most often stall, why inactivity occurs from authors' and reviewers' perspectives, and how stalling relates to later contributor and reviewer engagement. We analyzed 14,234 stalled PRs and 164,562 review comments from 19 popular GitHub repositories using stale-bot workflows. An LLM-based voting classifier categorized PRs by contribution type, while quantitative analysis was combined with qualitative coding of general and inline review discussions. Feature-enhancement and issue-fixing PRs formed the largest share, together exceeding 77% of classified stalled PRs. General comments linked stalling mainly to communication and coordination breakdowns, including missing interaction, delayed feedback, and unclear follow-up. Inline comments showed that inactivity does not always reflect disengagement: many PRs were blocked by technical or dependency issues, including failing checks, configuration problems, compatibility concerns, and environment mismatches. Only 39.56% of contributors later submitted another PR, and reviewer re-engagement with the same contributors was approximately 21%. PR inactivity is a socio-technical coordination problem involving communication, technical readiness, review ownership, and automation practices. We recommend type-aware triage, clearer review feedback, explicit ownership of next actions, CI blocker management, and cause-aware stale-bot interventions.

</details>


### [420] [From Code to Requirements: Agentic Reverse Engineering of Business Rules at Enterprise Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22719)
*Garima Agrawal,Prasun Das,Priyanka L,Minisha N,Akshay Sarvade,Hemath Manivanan,Sravani Joshna,Prasad Kalyansundaram*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多智能体框架，通过逆向工程无文档的企业软件，自主生成业务需求文档（bRD），成本较传统迁移方式降低超98%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业软件的业务需求很少以结构化形式记录，逻辑散落在源代码、配置文件和机构记忆中。当系统需要迁移、扩展或审计时，缺乏正式需求文档迫使团队进行昂贵且易丢失知识的人工逆向工程。

Method: 框架由七个专门智能体协作：从代码、测试套件、配置和现有文档中发现用户旅程、提取业务规则并合成锁定的bRD；辅以静态分析工具，嵌入专家实践者的认知模型，并在受控升级点由人工审查者监督。

Result: 在真实企业部署的执行轨迹上评测，框架每项服务可在9分钟内生成全面bRD；提取的规则经真实生产缺陷记录独立佐证。此前同类迁移耗时超两年，本框架基于IFPUG复杂度模型和行业基准人力费率，实现超98%的成本削减。

Conclusion: 该智能体框架能高效、低成本地逆向生成企业软件业务需求文档，显著优于传统人工迁移方式。

Abstract: Business requirements for enterprise software systems are rarely captured in structured form; the logic resides instead in source code, configuration files, and institutional memory. When these systems must be migrated, extended, or audited, the absence of formal requirements artifacts forces teams into expensive, knowledge-losing manual reverse engineering. This paper presents an agentic framework that autonomously generates Business Requirements Documents (bRDs) through reverse engineering of undocumented enterprise software. Seven specialized agents collaborate to discover user journeys, extract business rules, and synthesize a locked bRD from code, test suites, configuration, and available documentation, supported by static analysis tools, guided by embedded expert practitioner cognitive models, and overseen by human reviewers at controlled escalation points. Measured on actual execution traces across a real enterprise deployment, the framework generates comprehensive bRDs in under nine minutes per service, with extracted rules independently corroborated against real production defect records. In a comparable prior migration to the same target architecture, delivery required over two years; on the present programme the framework achieves a cost reduction exceeding 98% against a baseline derived from actual repository metrics using IFPUG complexity models and industry benchmark labor rates.

</details>


### [421] [Towards the Generalizability of Leveraging ChatGPT in APR via Self-enhancing: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22844)
*Qingyuan Li,Chuanyi Li,Yaopeng Yang,Ziwen Ge,Jidong Ge,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文评估三种ChatGPT增强型APR方法在多个基准上的稳定性，发现增强增益随基准与模型变化，跨基准泛化性存疑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ChatGPT增强型APR（如自校正、自主智能体）在Defects4J和SWE-bench上报告了强劲结果，但其增益在不同基准间的稳定性尚未被充分探索，需要验证跨基准的泛化性。

Method: 在三个代表性长期基准上评估三种ChatGPT增强型APR方法；通过代码变换和基准特定微调探究基准相关因素；并对比直接向GPT-3.5-Turbo提供错误信息与触发测试的效果。

Result: GPT-3.5-Turbo下，SRepair在HumanEval-Java上的绝对增益大于Defects4J，且SRepair与FixAgent在BugsInPy上无外部信息时增益为负；GPT-5.4-mini下，各方法在Defects4J上增益更大，BugsInPy增益非负但有限。代码变换降低Defects4J增益，基准特定微调提升BugsInPy增益；直接提供错误信息与触发测试在BugsInPy上比增强方法修复更正确。

Conclusion: 需使用多指标跨基准、跨模型评估泛化性；当增强方法增益有限时，直接提供修复相关的外部信息可能更有效。

Abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) increasingly relies on Large Language Models (LLMs). ChatGPT-enhanced APR uses techniques such as self-correction and autonomous agents to improve repair without modifying model parameters. Although these approaches report strong results on Defects4J and SWE-bench, the stability of enhancement gains across benchmarks remains under-explored. We evaluate three ChatGPT-enhanced APR methods on three representative, long-standing benchmarks. With GPT-3.5-Turbo, SRepair achieves a larger absolute gain on HumanEval-Java than on Defects4J, while SRepair and FixAgent without extrinsic information yield negative gains on BugsInPy. With GPT-5.4-mini, the evaluated methods achieve larger absolute gains on Defects4J than on HumanEval-Java, while gains on BugsInPy are non-negative but limited. We investigate benchmark-related factors through code transformations and benchmark-specific fine-tuning. Code transformations reduce enhancement gains on Defects4J, while benchmark-specific fine-tuning increases gains on BugsInPy. Directly supplying GPT-3.5-Turbo with error messages and triggering tests yields more correct repairs than the evaluated ChatGPT-enhanced APR methods on BugsInPy. These findings highlight the need to evaluate generalizability across benchmarks and models using multiple metrics, and suggest that directly providing repair-specific extrinsic information may be more effective than enhancement methods when their gains are limited.

</details>


### [422] ["It Comes in Notebooks": Changes and Challenges when Operationalizing ML Prototypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22903)
*Arumoy Shome,Luís Cruz,Diomidis Spinellis,Arie van Deursen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文通过13位ML从业者的访谈，揭示了从计算笔记本到生产系统的过渡工作，提出"监督债务"概念，将操作化定义为偿还原型阶段累积技术债的过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML从业者常在笔记本中做原型再迁移到生产系统，但这一过渡的具体工程工作和背后的软件质量关切尚未被充分刻画。

Method: 对来自工业界和学术界的13位ML从业者进行半结构化访谈，采用反思性主题分析。

Result: 识别出23项工程变更，归为五类主题（代码重构、数据管道开发、测试与验证、管道自动化、监控与可观测性）；识别出20项贯穿生命周期的软件质量属性并与工程变更对应；归纳7项质量权衡。

Conclusion: 笔记本将监督外部化给人类并推迟成本，操作化即偿还"监督债务"；这些张力是笔记本到生产过渡的固有属性而非劣质工程的表现，为实践者、工具设计者和研究者提供启示。

Abstract: Machine learning practitioners commonly prototype models in computational notebooks before transitioning them to automated production systems. Despite its prevalence, the concrete engineering work involved in this transition and the software quality concerns that motivate it remain insufficiently characterized. We report on a qualitative study based on semi-structured interviews with 13 ML practitioners from industry and academia. Using reflexive thematic analysis, we identify 23 engineering changes organized into five themes: code restructuring, data pipeline development, testing & validation, pipeline automation, and monitoring & observability. We also identify 20 software quality attributes across the ML development lifecycle and map them to the engineering changes. A recurring pattern in our findings is that computational notebooks externalize oversight to the human practitioner, and defer costs that become obligatory at operationalization time. Operationalization constitutes the repayment of this technical debt accumulated during prototyping, which we refer to as oversight debt. Practitioners do not merely restructure notebook code, but repay this debt by constructing automated substitutes for the interactive oversight that notebooks provide. We further present seven quality trade-offs showing that these tensions are properties of the notebook-to-production transition, rather than symptoms of poor engineering practice. Our findings structure operationalization effort, establish empirical links between engineering changes and software quality concerns, and provide implications for practitioners, tool designers, and researchers working on ML-enabled software systems.

</details>


### [423] [Characterizing Feedback Statements in Machine Learning Jupyter Notebooks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22912)
*Arumoy Shome,Lu\is Cruz,Diomidis Spinellis,Arie van Deursen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究Jupyter notebook中用于捕捉"静默失败"的反馈语句，通过挖掘近30万公开notebook提取109万条反馈语句，构建了反映功能意图与ML流程阶段的分类法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML开发是迭代且反馈驱动的，许多ML失败不会抛出异常，因而无法被现有基于崩溃(crash)的分析方法发现。作者希望理解实践者检查什么来捕捉这些静默失败，编码其对代码应有行为及可能出错的认知模型。

Method: 从GitHub和Kaggle挖掘297,851个公开Python Jupyter notebook，提取1,092,780条反馈语句（区分探索性显示语句和验证性断言语句）；基于CodeBERT嵌入做语义聚类，按比例分层抽样816条语句，用扎根理论和开放编码进行标注分析，构建分类法，并与已有崩溃分类法对比。

Result: 提出ML notebook反馈语句分类法，按功能意图和ML流程阶段组织；发现反馈以探索性为主，两大平台呈现质上不同的ML工作模式；分类法能捕捉崩溃分析无法观察到的防御性静默失败实践。

Conclusion: notebook源码应被视为ML开发者实践研究中的混杂因素；研究揭示了notebook工具化的机会，并推动对静默ML失败的实证研究。作者公开了109万条反馈语句语料和编码手册以支持复现与工具研究。

Abstract: Machine learning development in Jupyter notebooks is iterative and feedback-driven. Practitioners author statements that reveal information about program execution and use it to decide what to do next. We call these feedback statements and identify two forms: exploratory statements that display values for visual inspection, and validation statements that enforce conditions programmatically through assertions. Many ML failures do not surface as exceptions and thus escape the crash-based analyses that dominate prior work on ML notebooks. This study examines what practitioners check to catch failures that would otherwise pass silently, by characterizing feedback statements that encode the practitioner's mental model of what the code should do and what could go wrong. We mine 297,851 public Python Jupyter notebooks from GitHub and Kaggle and extract 1,092,780 feedback statements. We sample 816 statements through proportional stratified sampling from semantic clusters obtained from CodeBERT embeddings, and apply grounded theory and open coding to label and analyze each one. We contribute a taxonomy of feedback statements in ML notebooks, organized along the functional intent of the statement and the ML pipeline stage in which it appears. The taxonomy reveals that feedback is overwhelmingly exploratory, and that the two platforms host qualitatively different modes of ML work. Mapping our taxonomy to an existing crash taxonomy shows that it captures defensive practices against silent failures that crash analysis cannot observe. Our findings indicate that notebook source should be treated as a confounder in studies of ML developer practice, surface opportunities for notebook tooling, and motivate empirical study of silent ML failures. We release the corpus of 1,092,780 feedback statements and the codebook to support replication and tooling research.

</details>


### [424] [NostrAgent: A Decentralized Identity and Delegation Architecture for Sovereign Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22944)
*Oliver Aleksander Larsen,Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NostrAgent是一个去中心化架构，通过Nostr relays上的三种自定义事件类型（身份、范围化委托链、同行证明），统一了自治AI代理所需的五项能力：持久身份、范围化委托、同行信任、发现与支付。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自治AI代理日益跨组织边界行动（调用第三方服务、委托子任务、为计量资源付费），但现有的身份、委托、信任、发现和支付能力分散在各自系统中，且依赖中心化权威或仅覆盖子集，导致密钥轮换或委托撤销时权威、信任与支付恰好断裂。因此需要一个去中心化、可连续运作的统一架构。

Method: 基于Nostr relays构建，使用三种自定义事件类型：Kind 38100身份声明（BIP340 Schnorr签名+预轮换承诺）、Kind 38101范围化委托链（每一跳可验证地收窄授权能力）、Kind 38102同行证明（形成抗女巫攻击的信任图），并用Lightning HTTP 402（L402）将支付绑定到代理身份。评估采用混合方法：ATAM质量分析（两轮迷你Delphi专家小组）、跨三个信任边界的STRIDE威胁建模、11项基准测试（非参数统计）以及19种故障模式分析。

Result: 离线验证达亚毫秒级，委托链呈线性扩展，Lightning结算的L402在regtest上中位数为157毫秒。19种故障模式中17种通过实证验证，1种为解析边界，1种作为架构局限被披露。

Conclusion: NostrAgent展示了一个可审计的原型基底，可在无中心化信任根的情况下支持可信的代理系统；身份保持操作者主权、relays仅为可替换传输层而非信任根，且每项授权决策均可离线从签名事件重放。

Abstract: Autonomous AI agents increasingly act across organizational boundaries on behalf of human operators: they invoke third-party services, delegate subtasks to other agents, and pay for metered resources. Deploying such agents safely requires five capabilities that today live in separate systems: persistent identity, scoped delegation, peer trust, discovery, and payment. Existing approaches root these in centralized authorities or cover only subsets, so authority, trust, and payment fracture exactly where autonomy needs continuity: when a key rotates or a delegation must be revoked. We present NostrAgent, a decentralized architecture that unifies all five over Nostr relays using three custom event kinds: Kind 38100 identity declarations authenticated by BIP340 Schnorr signatures with pre-rotation commitments, Kind 38101 scoped delegation chains whose every hop verifiably narrows granted capabilities, and Kind 38102 peer attestations forming a Sybil-deterrent trust graph, with Lightning HTTP 402 (L402) binding payment to agent identity. Identity remains operator-sovereign without any registration authority; relays are substitutable transport rather than a trust root; and every authorization decision is replayable offline from signed events. We evaluate a Python prototype with a mixed-method design: ATAM quality analysis with a two-round mini-Delphi panel, STRIDE threat modeling across three trust boundaries, eleven benchmarks with non-parametric statistics, and 19 failure modes. Results show sub-millisecond offline verification, linear delegation-chain scaling, and Lightning-settled L402 at 157 ms median on regtest. 17 of 19 failure modes pass empirically, one is bounded analytically, and one is disclosed as an architectural limitation. NostrAgent demonstrates an auditable prototype substrate for trustworthy agentic systems without centralized trust roots.

</details>


### [425] [Diversity-Guided Search-Based Testing of Large Language Model Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23209)
*Lev Sorokin,Ivan Vasilev,Ken E. Friedl,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一种基于搜索的LLM应用测试框架，将失败多样性作为显式优化目标，通过档案库距离奖励与重填充算子维持探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM应用易产生不准确、虚构或有害响应，其高维输入空间使系统化测试困难，需兼顾失败数量与失败类型的多样性。

Method: 在风格、内容与扰动维度上做离散化，维护生成测试的档案库并奖励与档案库的距离；用重填充算子定期替换种群中非失败测试以维持探索，采样策略包括均匀采样与贪心距离最大化。

Result: 在LLM安全、车载导航、车内功能控制三个案例（5个被测系统、8个LLM、18种配置、超百万次测试）中，所有引导变体几乎在所有配置下都比随机与组合搜索发现更多失败；多样化搜索发现失败较少但覆盖更广的失败类型，贪心重填充权衡最佳。

Conclusion: 将失败多样性纳入优化目标可有效提升LLM应用测试的失败发现与类型覆盖，贪心重填充策略在二者间取得最佳平衡。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based applications are increasingly deployed across domains including customer service, education, and mobility. These systems are prone to inaccurate, fictitious, or harmful responses, and their vast, high-dimensional input space makes systematic testing particularly challenging. In this paper, we present a search-based testing framework for LLM-based applications that incorporates failure diversity as an explicit optimization objective. Building on a discretization along stylistic, content-related, and perturbation dimensions, our framework maintains an archive of generated tests and rewards distance from that archive, while a repopulation operator periodically replaces non-failing tests in the population to sustain exploration. The repopulation operator is parameterized by its sampling strategy: replacement candidates are drawn either uniformly or by greedy distance maximization, two settings we compare empirically.
  We evaluate both against several baselines across three case studies---LLM safety, in-car navigation, and in-vehicle function control---covering five systems under test, eight LLMs, and 18 distinct test configurations, with over one million executed tests. Our results show that all guided variants detect substantially more failures than random and combinatorial search in nearly all configurations. Among them, diversified search detects fewer failures, but covers a broader range of failure types in all case studies, with greedy repopulation offering the best tradeoff.

</details>


### [426] [Specification Before Generation: A Pre-Registered, Five-Model Paired Evaluation of a Specification Frame for LLM-Generated Code in Money, Time, Idempotency, and Access Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23270)
*Sandeep Dhuri*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过在提示词中加入固定"规格框架"，可显著降低前沿LLM生成后端代码的安全缺陷；五大模型全部受益，独立扫描器验证一致，且效果在模型默认行为最弱处最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成代码的安全通过率四年几乎未提升，而金融、医疗、保险等受监管后端最关注金额运算、时间处理、重试安全和访问控制等缺陷。现有指令文件（instruction files）在最大规模对照研究中未显示收益，因此作者探索更窄的思路：让提示词携带明确的"规格"（对结果必须成立的条件）。

Method: 研究预注册假设、反驳条件、分析代码和一次性生成规则。选取来自金融/医疗/保险实践的50个真实后端任务，测试来自五家厂商的五款前沿模型；每个任务跑两次：裸提示与前置267词规格框架。用九个确定性AST检查器评分，并用不了解框架的Bandit安全扫描器独立评分，共500份输出。

Result: 框架使全部五个模型缺陷减少（每任务平均减少0.16至0.70项，所有Holm校正符号检验显著，所有bootstrap置信区间不含零）；在出现差异时框架组100次中赢95次，从未在任何领域使任何模型变差。Bandit在裸组发现53个中高问题，框架组仅11个，方向对所有模型一致。效果在模型无提示时默认最弱的方面最大。

Conclusion: 固定规格框架能为模型补足其缺乏的工程纪律，稳健降低受监管后端代码的安全缺陷，独立扫描器验证一致。全部输出、提示、检查器、评分代码与预注册均以DOI公开，任何团队可复现结果而无需信任作者。

Abstract: Code generated by large language models passes security checks at a rate that has barely moved in four years. In regulated backends, the defect classes that matter most are money arithmetic, time handling, retry safety, and access control. Teams answer with instruction files, yet the largest controlled study of instruction files to date found no benefit. This paper tests a narrower idea: generated code improves when the prompt carries a specification, a fixed preamble stating what must be true of the result. We pre-registered hypotheses, refuters, analysis code, and a one-shot generation rule, then ran 50 realistic backend tasks from finance, healthcare, and insurance practice through five frontier models from five vendor lineages, each task twice: bare, and preceded by a 267-word filled specification frame. Nine deterministic AST-based checkers scored the outputs. The Bandit security scanner, which knows nothing of the frame, scored them independently. The frame reduced defects in all five models (mean reduction 0.16 to 0.70 findings per task, every Holm-adjusted sign test significant, every bootstrap confidence interval excluding zero). Where the arms differed, the frame arm won 95 of 100 times. It never made any model worse in any domain. Bandit found 53 medium-or-high issues in the bare arm and 11 in the frame arm, in the same direction for every model. The effect was largest where a model's unprompted defaults were weakest: the frame supplies the discipline a model lacks. All 500 outputs, prompts, checkers, scoring code, and the pre-registration are published with a DOI, so any team can re-derive the result without trusting the author.

</details>


### [427] [One to More, More to One: Category-Aware Iterative Expert Training for Software Engineering Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23377)
*Jie Zhao,Ziyu Jiang,Suhang Zheng,Minghui Shan,Xiaoxiao Xu,Lin Qu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出类别感知的专家训练与策略整合框架，解决仓库级SWE中池化RL导致的类别跷跷板问题，最终策略在Pro-618和SWE-bench Multilingual上分别提升5.39和2.78个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库级软件工程包含异质任务类别，池化智能体强化学习下各类别进展不均：部分类别提升伴随其他类别退步，而总体解决率掩盖了这些变化（"类别跷跷板"现象），需要类别感知的训练与整合方案。

Method: 1) 可执行任务构建 + SWE Labeler（基于证据的多轴标注系统）组织训练池；2) 类别专属RL训练，采用同源类别专家交替进行长时程 Agentic-miniRL 与 Refresh-Repair-Expand（RRE，刷新实例掌握度、复用自身验证成功轨迹做Repair SFT、重选任务再RL）；3) 标签路由的多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）整合为单一学生模型，用ReLU门控奖励外推只保留各教师相对参考的改进方向。全程无需外部模型提供解题轨迹或动作目标。

Result: 最终MOPD策略在Pro-618上平均解决率58.04%，SWE-bench Multilingual上59.00%，分别较基座模型提升5.39和2.78个百分点；并通过聚合与逐类别解决率、相对各联合RL基线的最小类别提升、专家增益恢复等指标评估。

Conclusion: 类别感知的专家训练与无外部监督的策略整合能有效缓解池化RL的类别跷跷板问题，实现单一可部署学生模型在多个基准上的稳定提升。

Abstract: Repository-level software engineering (SWE) comprises heterogeneous task categories, whose progress under pooled agentic reinforcement learning can be uneven: gains in some categories coincide with regressions in others, while aggregate resolution obscures these changes. Motivated by this category see-saw, we develop a category-aware expert-training and policy-integration framework. Executable task construction and SWE Labeler, an evidence-grounded multi-axis labeling system, organize the training pools. Initial category-specific RL improves average training success while leaving uneven instance-level progress, motivating explicit consolidation of successful behavior and policy-adaptive task selection. Same-origin category experts alternate long-horizon Agentic-miniRL with Refresh-Repair-Expand (RRE): the updated policy refreshes instance mastery, reuses its own verified successful trajectories for Repair SFT, and reselects tasks for further RL. Label-routed multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates the experts into one deployable student, with ReLU-gated reward extrapolation keeping only each teacher's improving direction over the reference. Expert training and policy integration require no external model to provide solution trajectories or action targets. We evaluate Pooled RL and Balanced RL, expert development, and single-model integration through aggregate and per-category resolution, the minimum category lift over each joint-RL baseline, and expert-gain recovery. The final MOPD policy achieves mean resolution of 58.04% on Pro-618 and 59.00% on SWE-bench Multilingual, improving over the base model by 5.39 and 2.78 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [428] [Omni2Web: Benchmarking Audiovisual Website Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23417)
*Minghao Han,Zhenghao Xing,Xize Cheng,Yuxuan Wang,Junming Lin,Ling Wang,Yinsong Yan,Yunfei Chu,Qize Yang,Jin Xu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出Omni2Web双语基准，评估从屏幕录制中恢复弱指示语编辑意图的能力，发现多模态意图恢复与代码执行仍有巨大提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 屏幕录制网页编辑请求包含依赖语音、光标轨迹、页面状态和编辑历史的弱指示语（如"this"、"there"），现有基准假设指令明确，无法覆盖此类需意图恢复的场景。

Method: 构建Omni2Web双语基准，含918个实例、13,907编辑步骤，设三条互补赛道：Direct Editing（从录制直接编辑）、Instruction Recovery（恢复显式意图）、Instruction Utility（检验恢复指令能否驱动固定代码执行器）。评估17个开源与闭源模型，并进行步级分析与控制消融。

Result: 最优模型Direct Editing EFS为51.17，Instruction Recovery IRS为49.14；固定执行器下最强恢复指令EFS为51.08，远低于oracle指令的89.69。步级分析显示正确grounding不保证编辑成功，部分Omni模型恢复的指令被固定编码模型执行效果优于其直接编辑；消融证明时序对齐视听证据的价值，替换评判者保持领先与排序。

Conclusion: 多模态意图恢复与代码执行存在显著提升空间，将Omni重写器与编码模型配对的方案具有前景。

Abstract: Screen-recorded web editing requests contain weak deictic expressions such as ``this'' and ``there,'' whose referents depend on speech, cursor trajectories, page state, and edit history. Such requests require intent recovery beyond the explicit specifications assumed by many existing web-editing benchmarks. We introduce Omni2Web, a bilingual benchmark of 918 instances spanning 13,907 edit steps. It defines three complementary tracks: Direct Editing evaluates webpage editing from recordings, Instruction Recovery measures explicit intent recovery, and Instruction Utility tests whether recovered instructions can drive a fixed code executor. We evaluate 17 open- and closed-source models. The best models attain 51.17 on the Edit Fidelity Score (EFS) for Direct Editing and 49.14 on the Instruction Recovery Score (IRS); under the fixed executor, the strongest recovered instructions reach 51.08 EFS, still far below the 89.69 EFS obtained with oracle instructions. Step-level analyses show that correct grounding does not guarantee successful edits, while some Omni models recover instructions that the fixed coding model executes substantially better than their direct edits. Controlled ablations further demonstrate the value of temporally aligned audiovisual evidence, while alternative judges preserve the leader and broad ordering. Together, these findings reveal substantial headroom in multimodal intent recovery and code execution and highlight the promise of pairing Omni rewriters with coding models.

</details>


### [429] [VSpector: Specification-Driven Bug Detection for RISC-V CPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23517)
*Tianyu Jia,Zhaoyang Yu,Yuanliang Chen,Wei You,Jianjun Huang,Bin Liang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VSpector：以官方自然语言RISC-V规范为信息源，用分阶段上下文精炼的LLM流水线检测CPU RTL实现中的规范违背，在CVA6和香山上确认148个违规、73个bug（42个新bug），精度68.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源RISC-V CPU的RTL设计bug检测对系统可靠性至关重要，但传统方法依赖预定义产物（参考模型、形式化性质、自定义bug模式），构建成本高且覆盖受限。作者希望直接利用官方自然语言规范作为bug检测信息源，避免这些专门化构造。

Method: VSpector是一条规范驱动的bug检测流水线，直接检查RTL实现是否遵守官方规范规则。为解决LLM中"广上下文范围"与"模型推理精度"的权衡，采用跨四阶段的逐步上下文精炼方案：规则提取、实现定位、候选识别、顺序违规审计。

Result: 在工业级RISC-V CPU CVA6和香山上评估：217个候选报告中人工确认148个真实违规，精度68.2%；对应73个不同bug，其中42个为先前未知bug。对比实验显示，SOTA CPU模糊测试器DiveFuzz在每CPU 24小时运行中未检测到任何这些新bug。42个新bug均已上报上游，开发者已修复19个并确认另外11个（共30个）。

Conclusion: 规范驱动的审计是一种实用且与现有方法互补的CPU bug检测策略，证明了利用官方自然语言规范进行RTL bug检测的有效性。

Abstract: Detecting RTL design bugs in open-source RISC-V CPU implementations is critical for ensuring system reliability. Traditional detection approaches inherently rely on predefined artifacts. In this paper, we leverage the official,natural-language RISC-V specifications as an effective information source for bug detection. We present VSpector, a specification-driven bug detection pipeline that directly checks whether CPU register-transfer level (RTL) implementations adhere to official specification rules, without requiring specialized construction of reference models, formal properties, or custom bug patterns. To resolve the key technical trade-off between broad context scope and model reasoning accuracy when using Large Language Models (LLMs), VSpector employs a stepwise context refinement scheme across a four-stage pipeline: rule extraction, implementation localization, candidate identification, and sequential violation auditing. We evaluate VSpector on two industrial-strength RISC-V CPUs, CVA6 and XiangShan. Out of 217 reported candidates, manual inspection confirmed 148 true violations, representing a 68.2% precision. These violations correspond to 73 distinct bugs, including 42 previously unknown bugs. In our comparative experiments, DiveFuzz, a state-of-the-art CPU fuzzer, detected none of these new bugs during 24-hour runs per CPU. All 42 new bugs have been reported upstream, with developers already fixing 19 and confirming an additional 11 (30 in total), demonstrating that specification-driven auditing is a practical and complementary strategy for CPU bug detection.

</details>


### [430] [VibeMemBench: Evaluating Memory Systems for Coding Agents on Real Repository Coding Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23570)
*Liyang Fan,Yingcheng Shi,Yongbin Li,Chenghao Sun,Xin Chen,Xander Xu,Hu Wei,Shiwen Ni,Min Yang,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 VibeMemBench 基准，评估记忆系统在真实仓库编码任务中的可执行效果，揭示现有记忆系统与仓库历史中有用经验之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库基准测试只测代码修改而不隔离记忆，记忆基准只测召回率而不测下游编码结果，因此无法判断记忆系统是否真正改进可执行仓库工作。

Method: 构建含 111 个来自 90 个 SWE-rebench V2 仓库的编码目标及 3,634 条历史轨迹的基准；每个目标须经参考设置验证注入历史经验能提升可执行结果方可保留；冻结的已验证经验迁移到五个留出求解器，agent 在声明记忆条件下编辑代码库，由可执行测试判定任务解决。

Result: 直接注入在四个求解器上提升任务解决率 1.1–4.5 个百分点，并在全部五个求解器上降低 agent 步数；但四个现有记忆系统在相同历史上构建并检索经验时，十二个求解器–系统组合中有十一个未能超过匹配的关闭记忆基线。

Conclusion: VibeMemBench 揭示了仓库历史所含有用经验与现有记忆系统实际交付经验之间的差距，为面向仓库编码的记忆系统评估提供真实可执行标准。

Abstract: Coding agents operate on real repository coding tasks, and persistent memory systems promise to reuse experience across tasks. Yet existing evaluations do not show whether those systems improve executable repository work. Repository benchmarks test code changes but do not isolate memory, while memory benchmarks score recall without measuring downstream coding outcomes. We introduce VibeMemBench, a benchmark for evaluating memory systems on 111 coding targets from 90 SWE-rebench V2 repositories and 3,634 history trajectories from the target repositories. The targets follow the SWE benchmark style and cover bug fixes, feature requests, interface changes, and configuration work. An agent edits each target codebase under a declared memory condition. Executable tests decide task resolution. Each target is retained only when injected history experience improves its executable outcome in a reference setting, so every target carries a prior experience whose usefulness is verified by execution in that setting. The frozen verified experience is then transferred to five held-out solvers. Direct injection raises observed task resolution on four of them by 1.1 to 4.5 percentage points while lowering agent steps on all five. Yet when four existing memory systems must construct and retrieve experience from the same history, eleven of twelve solver and system pairings fail to exceed the matched memory-off baseline. VibeMemBench exposes the gap between the useful experience that repository history holds and the experience existing memory systems deliver for repository coding tasks.

</details>


### [431] [Packaged, But Not Portable: Why Conforming to the Agent Plugin Standard Is Rare, and Why Conforming Would Not Be Enough](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23809)
*Tezan Sahu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文实证分析 Agent Plugins v1.0.0 标准的生态采用情况，发现仅 6.2% 插件通过验证（但 96.6% 只差一个样板字段），真正问题在于 40.2% 插件需丢弃作者字段才能加载，且 81% 能力导出插件重名而无命名空间或优先级规则。作者主张标准应补充组合模型，并提出 v1.1 增量配置文件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理通过插件（含技能、子代理、命令、钩子、工具服务器）扩展，2026年7月24日开放的 Agent Plugins v1.0.0 规范统一了插件布局与描述，使同一插件可跨代理运行。作者提出实践者关心的两个问题：(1) 生态是否在采纳该标准；(2) 即使插件符合规范，是否就足以与用户已装的其他插件协同工作。

Method: 构建 AgentPluginZoo——一个带来源追踪的插件语料库，覆盖 30,655 个仓库、68,072 个插件包，并公开发现台账、评分代码与分析。通过验证与静态分析量化合规率、加载失败成本与命名冲突。

Result: 仅 6.2% 通过验证，但 96.6% 补一个缺失样板字段即可加载，差距是浅层而非结构性。真正代价在别处：40.2% 可加载但规范要求客户端丢弃作者所写字段（多为声明插件所带内容）；组合问题更严重，81% 能力导出包与其他插件重名，且无命名空间或优先级规则决定由谁响应。

Conclusion: 社区标准化了打包格式，但组合需要模型。论文指出该模型必须新增四个概念——限定能力标识、声明的能力表面、优先级规则、插件间关系——并证明它们可作为同一规范的 v1.1 增量配置文件而非竞争标准。建议从业者与标准演进者采纳，尤其强调合规性必须可观测才能普及。

Abstract: Coding agents are extended by plugins: installable bundles that ship skills, sub-agents, commands, hooks, and tool servers. On 24 July 2026, an open specification (Agent Plugins v1.0.0) standardised how such a bundle is laid out and described, so that one plugin could run on any agent. We ask the two questions a practitioner would ask of it: is the ecosystem adopting the standard, and if a plugin did conform, would that be enough to make it work alongside the other plugins a user has installed?
  We answer both by building AgentPluginZoo, a provenance-tracked corpus of 68,072 plugin bundles across 30,655 repositories, released with its discovery ledger, scoring code, and analysis. Only 6.2% validate, but the gap is shallow rather than structural: 96.6% would load after adding one missing boilerplate field. The real cost lands elsewhere. 40.2% would load while the specification obliges the client to discard fields their authors wrote, mostly declarations of what the plugin ships. Moreover, conformance settles nothing for the second question: 81% of capability-exporting bundles share a name with another plugin, with no namespace or precedence rule to decide which one answers.
  This paper argues the community standardised a packaging format when composition needs a model, names the four concepts such a model must add - qualified capability identity, a declared capability surface, a precedence rule, and inter-plugin relations - and shows they fit an additive v1.1 profile of the same specification rather than a competing standard. Recommendations follow for practitioners packaging extensions today and for the people evolving the standard, chief among them that conformance must be made observable before it can become common. The corpus and code are available at https://github.com/tezansahu/agentpluginzoo

</details>


### [432] [MCPGen: Benchmarking LLMs on Executable MCPWorkflow Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23925)
*Yingxuan Yang,Jiaqi Liu,Lirui Guan,Jiaye Gao,Weiwen Liu,Weinan Zhang,Ying Wen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 MCPGen，一个面向 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 工作流开发的可执行基准，包含 100 个自包含项目、16 个应用域，评估工作流重建、工具创建与向后兼容扩展三类任务。评测 11 个 LLM 通过静态分析、单元/集成测试及端到端执行，发现模型在重建上达 88.5%，但端到端执行成功率无一超过 57%，集成是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多孤立评估 LLM 的图结构、工具实现、schema 绑定或运行时执行能力，或依赖轨迹级代理指标，无法判断生成的工作流产物能否真正端到端执行。正确性依赖于跨层一致性：工作流可能结构上合理，却因工具实现、schema 绑定或运行时执行不一致而失败。

Method: 构建 MCPGen 可执行基准，含 100 个自包含 MCP 项目，覆盖 16 个应用域；设计三项诊断任务（工作流重建、工具创建、向后兼容的工作流扩展）；在单轮基础模型设定下评测 11 个代表性 LLM，并通过静态分析、单元测试、集成测试和进程隔离的端到端执行来评估生成产物。

Result: 模型在工作流重建上达到 88.5%，但无一模型端到端执行成功率超过 57%；单工具单元测试通过率最高达 63.8%，而项目级集成成功率不超过 45%，表明即使孤立工具测试通过，集成仍是主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 跨层一致性（尤其是集成环节）是 LLM 生成可执行 MCP 工作流的关键瓶颈，孤立能力的高分并不代表端到端可执行；MCPGen 提供了诊断此类差距的可执行评测框架。

Abstract: We study whether LLMs can produce executable workflow artifacts that remain consistent across graph structure, tool implementation, schema bindings, and runtime wiring. In this setting, correctness depends on cross-layer consistency: a workflow may be structurally plausible, yet still fail because tool implementations, schema bindings, or runtime execution do not align. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate these capabilities in isolation or rely on trajectory-level proxies, leaving open whether generated workflow artifacts execute end-to-end. We introduce \textbf{MCPGen}, an executable benchmark for Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflow development. MCPGen contains 100 self-contained MCP projects across 16 application domains and evaluates three diagnostic tasks: workflow reconstruction, tool creation, and backward-compatible workflow extension. We evaluate 11 representative LLMs in a single-turn foundation-model setting, assessing generated artifacts through static analysis, unit and integration tests, and process-isolated end-to-end execution. Models reach 88.5\% on workflow reconstruction, but no model exceeds 57\% end-to-end execution success. Per-tool unit-test pass rates reach 63.8\%, while project-level integration success does not exceed 45\%, suggesting that integration remains a major bottleneck even when isolated tool tests pass.

</details>


### [433] [A Carbon-Aware Quantum Computing Framework for LCA-Driven Sustainability in Quantum Cloud Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24224)
*Muhammad Umar,Nauman Arshad,Azeem Akbar,Arif Ali Khan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文把量子计算碳意识框架从平台级扩展到服务级，将超导量子计算机全生命周期评估结果转化为量子云服务（QCS）供应商的减碳指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子计算的环境足迹相较经典基础设施研究不足，且随着量子计算走向云交付，QCS供应商除了平台级碳核算框架外缺乏可操作指导。

Method: 基于超导量子平台"摇篮到坟墓"的LCA结果，构建服务级碳意识量子计算（CQC）框架，包括服务级隐含碳分配、负载无关与负载成比例的运营碳分解，以及基于工作负载的应用碳抵消。

Result: 五年足迹为583 t CO2e（GKP）与10,570 t（surface code），隐含碳占77.3-85.2%；运营与隐含碳持平需17.0-28.7年，而经典对比系统仅2.7年。供应商杠杆排序为利用率（19.7倍增益）>服务寿命延长（59.9%）>电力供应（6.5倍），运营效率与可再生采购杠杆有限。

Conclusion: 超导量子计算机在结构上以隐含碳为主导，颠覆了经典可持续性直觉，需要在量子基础设施扩展中直接进行功耗测量与跨架构验证。

Abstract: Quantum computing's environmental footprint remains poorly understood relative to classical infrastructure, and as quantum computing moves toward cloud delivery, Quantum Cloud Service (QCS) providers lack actionable guidance beyond platform-level carbon-accounting frameworks. Objective: This study extends the carbon-aware quantum computing (CQC) framework from a platform-level to a service-level model that translates empirical life cycle assessment (LCA) findings of a superconducting quantum computer into guidance for QCS providers. Method: We modeled the CQC framework via service-level embodied-carbon allocation, load-independent and load-proportional operational decomposition, and a workload-resolved application offset on the basis of results acquired through a cradle-to-grave LCA of a superconducting quantum platform. Results: The five-year footprint is 583 t CO2e (GKP) and 10,570 t (surface-code), dominated by embodied carbon (77.3-85.2%), with operational-embodied parity not reached until 17.0-28.7 years versus 2.7 years for classical comparators. This reorders provider levers: utilisation yields the largest gain (19.7x), followed by service life extension (59.9%) and electricity supply (6.5x), while operational efficiency and renewable procurement offer limited leverage. Conclusion: Superconducting quantum computers are structurally embodied-carbon-dominated, inverting classical sustainability intuition and motivating direct power measurement and cross-architecture validation as quantum infrastructure scales.

</details>


### [434] [Fault-Class-Matched Test Oracles for Output-Invisible Quantum Transpiler Regressions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24230)
*Furqan Nasir,Arif Shah,Iftikhar Alam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出面向量子转译器的故障类别匹配、布局感知的分层oracle家族，弥补传统输出等价oracle在元数据、全局相位和可复现性通道上的盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统测试oracle仅通过对比编译输出（态矢量、采样分布或模全局相位的幺正）判断正确性，但约28%的已合并Qiskit转译器缺陷修复涉及布局元数据、全局相位或运行间可复现性损坏，此类故障输出仍正确，黑盒输出等价oracle按构造无法察觉。

Method: 设计故障类别匹配、布局感知、宽度分层的oracle家族：针对元数据通道的布局/置换契约检查器与契约级变形关系（MR-1），针对相位通道的全局相位追踪器，针对可复现性的确定性运行器；在9个真实已合并Qiskit回归上从源码验证，并进行675配置扫描及合成变异体测试。

Result: 输出等价oracle全程失明，匹配机制在每个案例上均触发；675配置扫描无假阳性；合成变异体上契约/元数据与全局相位通道各36个变异体达到1.00灵敏度与特异度，可复现性灵敏度1.00（95% CI 0.44-1.00）；契约检查器成本比普通输出检查低2-6个数量级；移植至pytket/tket后全局相位机制同样达1.00/1.00，相位恢复至双精度。

Conclusion: 故障类别匹配的oracle家族有效弥补输出等价oracle的盲区，成本低且可跨框架迁移，表明该问题非Qiskit特有产物。

Abstract: Test oracles for quantum transpilers typically judge correctness by comparing compiled output against a reference: a statevector, a sampled distribution, or a unitary compared modulo global phase. A companion empirical study measures how often that choice fails. Roughly 28% of merged Qiskit transpiler bug-fixes (95% Wilson CI 19-40%) repair a fault that corrupts layout metadata, global phase, or run-to-run reproducibility while output stays correct: invisible to a black-box output-equivalence oracle by construction. This paper closes that gap with a fault-class-matched, layout-aware, width-tiered oracle family: a layout/permutation contract checker and a contract-level metamorphic relation (MR-1) for the metadata channel, a global-phase tracker for the phase channel, and a determinism runner for reproducibility. Verified from source on nine real, merged Qiskit transpiler regressions (three per channel), the output-equivalence oracle is blind throughout and the matched mechanism fires on every case. A 675-configuration sweep of the contract/metadata invariant finds no false positive. Synthetic mutant families confirm reliability at scale: 1.00 sensitivity and specificity across 36 mutants apiece for the contract/metadata and global-phase channels, and 1.00 sensitivity (95% CI 0.44-1.00) for reproducibility on the three circuits where the mutation is constructible. The contract checker costs two to six orders of magnitude less than a plain output check, the global-phase tracker is comparably cheap within its exact tier, and only the metamorphic relation carries a bounded cost. Ported natively to pytket/tket, the global-phase mechanism transfers cleanly, an identical 1.00/1.00 result with phases recovered to double-precision accuracy, evidence against a Qiskit-specific artifact.

</details>


### [435] [Evaluating the effectiveness of class-level LLM-generated test suites in Python](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24341)
*Bilal Al-Ahmad,M. Harshvardhan,Khaled El-Fakih,Anas AlSobeh*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究以ClassEval为基准，从可执行性、覆盖率、变异检测与结构质量多维评估LLM生成的Python测试套件，发现可执行性应作为前置门槛，模型选择比提示词策略更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM能快速生成单元测试，但高结构覆盖率不等于测试可可靠执行或能检测缺陷；既有研究多以覆盖率为主要结果，缺乏在类级别通过变异测试比较提示策略与模型的工作。

Method: 在ClassEval基准上，对多种LLM配置采用多种提示策略生成Python测试，结合执行结果、行/分支覆盖率、Cosmic Ray变异分数及结构质量指标评估；以成功执行作为前提，仅在可执行子集共享的类上做配对比较。

Result: 结构覆盖率普遍接近上限、区分度低；可执行性差异显著；所提提示在变异分数上表现好但无提示在所有模型上占优；模型选择解释的变异多于提示选择，且两者交互表明提示效果依赖模型；由于人类与LLM套件的可执行子集不同，其相对变异分数不足以证明优劣。

Conclusion: 可靠评估LLM生成测试应将可执行性作为门槛，并结合覆盖率、变异测试与结构质量指标；实践中应先选模型再调提示词。

Abstract: Context: Large language models (LLMs) can generate unit tests quickly, but high structural coverage does not establish that those tests execute reliably or detect faults. Existing evidence often treats coverage as the principal outcome and rarely compares prompt strategies and models through mutation testing at class level. Objective: This study examines how prompt strategy and model choice shape the executability, structural coverage, fault-detection effectiveness, and structural quality of LLM-generated Python test suites relative to human-written suites. Method: We evaluate multiple prompt strategies across a diverse set of current LLM configurations on the ClassEval benchmark. The evaluation combines execution outcomes, line and branch coverage, Cosmic Ray mutation scores, and structural quality indicators. Primary analyses treat successful execution as a prerequisite; paired comparisons use only classes shared by the relevant executable subsets. Results: Structural coverage is consistently near its ceiling and offers little discrimination among configurations. Executability varies substantially. The proposed prompt performs strongly for mutation score, but no prompt dominates across models. Model choice explains more variation than prompt choice, and their interaction shows that prompt effectiveness depends on the selected model. Human and LLM suites are evaluated on unequal executable subsets, so their relative mutation scores do not establish superiority. Conclusion: Reliable assessment of LLM-generated tests should treat executability as a gate and combine coverage with mutation testing and structural quality indicators. In practice, model selection should precede prompt tuning.

</details>


### [436] [A Lean and Spec-Driven AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle for Applied AI Education: The AI-SDLC Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24348)
*Andreas Martin,Sandro Schwander*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出并评估一个轻量级、规范驱动的生命周期，用于受治理的智能体软件工程，结合软件工程实践与仓库本地指导（specifications、AGENTS.md、阶段化技能文件）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体已支持规划、实现、测试等仓库级任务，但实际使用与既有软件工程实践联系薄弱。

Method: 在FHNW课程"AI-assisted Software Development"中开发该生命周期，学生将其应用于业务导向软件用例，并通过结合封闭评分项与开放问题的问卷调查探索其教育与实用适用性。

Result: 通过学生问卷调查（封闭评分与开放问题）评估了其教育与实践适用性。

Conclusion: 贡献是一个面向过程的框架，使AI编码智能体能在明确、可审查、面向测试的软件开发生命周期内以有限自主性运行。

Abstract: AI coding agents increasingly support software development beyond code completion, including planning, implementation, testing, and repository-level task execution. Their practical use, however, often remains only weakly connected to established software engineering practices. The aim of this work is to develop and evaluate a lightweight, spec-driven lifecycle for governed agentic software engineering. The lifecycle combines established software engineering practices with repository-local guidance through specifications, AGENTS.md, and phase-specific agent skill files. The approach was developed in the context of the FHNW course AI-assisted Software Development and applied by students to business-oriented software use cases. Its educational and practical applicability is explored through a student survey combining closed rating items with open-ended questions. The contribution of this work is a process-oriented framework that enables AI coding agents to operate with bounded autonomy within an explicit, reviewable, and test-oriented software development lifecycle.

</details>


### [437] [Trajectory-Aware Benchmark Subset Selection for Cost-Efficient Software Engineering Agent Regression Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24928)
*Mahmoud Ayyad,Zehao Wang,Jiho Shin,Ying Zou,Bram Adams*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出基于轨迹嵌入的子集选择方法，用少量测试实例估计SWE-agent整体性能，大幅降低评估成本且误差更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SWE-agent每次更新需重跑完整基准检测回归，单次消耗数亿LLM token，评估成为瓶颈。简单随机采样或按历史通过率分层采样方差大、代表性差。

Method: 利用agent轨迹（动作逐步记录）。先按最近一次全量测试的通过/失败结果分组以保持历史通过率，再用轨迹嵌入空间进行确定性选择。评估了76种子集选择配置（随机、嵌入选择、聚类、混合短名单-子采样），覆盖同配置重跑、模型/配置变更、框架变更三种回归场景。最佳方法为选择每组嵌入空间距质心最近的实例。

Result: 在5%或10%子集上，该方法相比最强基线的典型抽样降低平均估计误差3-11%、最坏情况4-11%；相比95分位抽样降低38-46%。最佳方法在所有方法中估计误差最低。

Conclusion: 10%轨迹感知子集可将中位数估计误差控制在5%以下，同时减少约90%的token成本。

Abstract: Autonomous software engineering agents (SWE-agents) automate coding tasks. Each agent update may require re-running the full benchmark to detect regressions and improvements, at a cost of hundreds of millions of LLM tokens per run, which makes evaluation a bottleneck. One solution is to evaluate only a subset of benchmark instances. Yet, simple approaches, such as random sampling or stratified random sampling based on past pass/fail outcomes, risk producing high variance and unrepresentative subsets. We turn to agent trajectories, the step-by-step record of the actions an agent took. We propose a trajectory-aware subset selection approach that replaces random sampling with deterministic selection based on trajectory embeddings. We first group test set instances by their test outcome in a recent full test run to preserve the historical pass/fail rate, then select the subset using the trajectory's embedding space.
  We evaluate 76 subset selection configurations, including random sampling, embedding-based selection, clustering-based selection, and hybrid shortlist-then-subsample strategies, across three regression scenarios: same-configuration reruns, model and configuration changes, and agent framework changes. Our best trajectory-aware method is the one selecting benchmark instances closest to the centroid of each outcome group in the embedding space. It achieves the lowest estimation error among all methods we evaluate. For instance, when evaluating a given agent version on a selected subset of 5% or 10% of the test instances, our approach reduces the average estimation error by 3--11% and the worst-case error by 4--11% relative to the typical draw and 38--46% relative to the 95th-percentile draw of the strongest baseline. Our results show that a 10% trajectory-aware subset keeps the median estimation error below 5% while cutting token cost by roughly 90%.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [438] [Didactic knowledge or Clinical Cases? How Data Types Shape Medical Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22161)
*Yuzheng Fan,Haochun Wang,Sendong Zhao,Xiao Han,Ming Ma,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过token匹配实验调整医学LLM训练数据的教学/临床比例，发现数据构成对模型能力的影响不对称，并提出数据配比应面向应用场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学大模型通常混合教学数据与临床数据训练，但这两类数据如何差异化影响模型能力尚不明确。

Method: 使用token匹配实验，变化教学与临床数据比例，在知识密集型与临床导向任务上分析性能、能力画像及错误模式。

Result: 发现不对称迁移：临床数据提升临床任务且知识任务仍有竞争力，教学数据主要提升知识任务；存在“知-行差距”；少量临床数据即可在EHR任务上获得大部分收益，最优比例随任务需求变化。

Conclusion: 医学LLM数据治理应以应用为导向，推理密集型场景宜采用更高临床数据比例。

Abstract: Medical large language models are commonly trained on mixtures of didactic data (e.g., textbooks) and clinical data (e.g., patient records), yet how these data types differentially shape model capabilities remains unclear. We address this issue with token-matched experiments that vary the didactic-to-clinical ratio and analyze how data composition affects performance, capability profiles, and error patterns across knowledge-intensive and clinic-oriented tasks. We uncover an asymmetric transfer across task types: clinical data improves clinic-oriented tasks while remaining competitive on knowledge-intensive ones, whereas didactic data mainly improves knowledge-intensive tasks. Error analysis suggests a knowing-doing gap, where improvements in knowledge recall do not reliably generalize to clinical reasoning. We further observe that modest amounts of clinical data yield most of the gains on EHR-grounded tasks, while the optimal mixture ratio varies with the knowledge and clinical reasoning demands of downstream tasks. These findings suggest that medical LLM data curation should be application-driven, with higher proportions of clinical data preferred for reasoning-intensive use cases.

</details>


### [439] [An Affordable AI-Integrated Smart Cane for Multimodal Mobility Assistance of Visually Impaired Users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22277)
*Ali Akarma,Adeel Ahmad,Toqeer Ali Syed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种价格约88美元、完全离线的AI智能拐杖，基于Raspberry Pi Zero 2W，融合RGB视觉与ToF测距，实现多模态出行辅助。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球超22亿人受视力障碍影响，传统白手杖无法检测高处障碍或提供语义环境信息，而现有AI导航系统依赖昂贵硬件或云端连接，难以在资源受限环境中普及。

Method: 系统融合RGB视觉与ToF距离估计，采用INT8量化的SSD MobileNet V1模型，结合距离感知的振动触觉反馈与实时音频警报；通过多进程架构将传感器采集、神经推理和触觉反馈隔离，并具备失效安全感知支持。

Result: 室内出行场景实验中宏平均F1为0.82（精确率0.85，召回率0.81），端到端平均延迟330ms，峰值功耗2.8W；12名参与者的初步可用性研究显示SUS为78.5，障碍感知有所增强。

Conclusion: 该原型验证了在成本敏感场景下部署隐私保护、边缘原生辅助智能的可行性。

Abstract: Visual impairment affects over 2.2 billion people worldwide, yet conventional white canes cannot detect elevated hazards or provide semantic environmental context. Existing AI-assisted navigation systems typically rely on expensive hardware or cloud connectivity, limiting accessibility in resource-constrained settings. This paper presents an affordable (\$88 USD), fully offline AI-integrated smart cane designed for multimodal mobility assistance on an ultra-low-power Raspberry Pi Zero 2W. The system fuses RGB vision sensing with Time-of-Flight (ToF) distance estimation, pairing an INT8-quantized SSD MobileNet V1 model with distance-aware vibrotactile feedback and real-time audio alerts. To ensure operational robustness on constrained hardware, a multiprocessing architecture isolates sensor acquisition, neural inference, and haptic feedback into independent processes with fail-safe sensing support. Experimental evaluation across indoor mobility scenarios demonstrates a macro-averaged F1-score of 0.82 (precision: 0.85, recall: 0.81), a mean end-to-end latency of 330\,ms, and a peak power draw of 2.8\,W. A preliminary usability study with 12 participants (SUS: 78.5, NASA-TLX) demonstrated positive user perception and enhanced obstacle awareness. The proposed prototype validates the feasibility of deploying privacy-preserving, edge-native assistive intelligence for cost-sensitive mobility assistance.

</details>


### [440] [PAANI : On Device Visual Evidence Fusion and Explainable Guidance for River Robot Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22353)
*Savio Cardoz,Santhiya Rajan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PAANI 是一个在 Arduino UNO Q 上运行的端侧感知到引导架构，融合 YOLO11n 检测、MobileNetV3-Small 分割与可解释走廊策略，为移动河道监测机器人提供带证据依据的实时建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理航点无法描述障碍物与水域边界，资源受限平台需将不完美的视觉预测转化为及时且可检查的引导；仅给出标签或转向指令无法说明依据及可靠性。

Method: 结合自定义训练的 YOLO11n 检测器与 MobileNetV3-Small 语义分割器，在 Arduino UNO Q 上做时间戳对齐的证据融合；有界跟踪维持目标持续，显式走廊策略综合表面标签、接受检测、紧迫度与掩码不确定性，每条建议公开其证据与策略理由；ROS 2 连接本地 AI 管线与独立 Gazebo 船舶定位控制测试床。

Result: 训练用 10,000 张 WaterScenes 做四类检测、1,127 张 MaSTr1325 做分割（含198验证图）；FP32 ONNX 模型共 14.817 MB；检测 checkpoint 测试 mAP@0.5 为 0.7388，矩形 ONNX 导出验证 mAP@0.5 为 0.7367；分割验证 mIoU 0.9750；5 分钟录制在 0.5 Hz 下流水线延迟中位数 467.8 ms、95 分位 580.3 ms；发现黑色输入误分类与采样率不匹配导致表观运动估计证据不足。

Conclusion: 结果支持一个可检查、可复用的边缘机器人基础，但需明确区分模型精度与端侧执行，与实际验证的水上避碰能力不同。

Abstract: Mobile river monitoring robots must interpret obstacles and water boundaries that geographic waypoints alone cannot describe. On resource constrained platforms, converting imperfect visual predictions into timely and inspectable guidance is a distinct challenge. An object label or steering command does not explain which evidence supports a decision or when that evidence is unreliable. We present PAANI, an on-device perception to guidance architecture that combines a project trained YOLO11n detector and a custom MobileNetV3 Small semantic segmenter with timestamp aligned evidence fusion on Arduino UNO Q. Bounded tracking supplies object persistence, while an explicit corridor policy combines surface labels, accepted detections, urgency and mask uncertainty. Each final advisory exposes its contributing evidence and policy reasons. ROS 2 interfaces connect the local AI pipeline to a separate Gazebo vessel, localization and control testbed. Training uses 10,000 WaterScenes images for four-class detection and 1,127 MaSTr1325 images for segmentation, including 198 segmentation validation images. The selected FP32 ONNX models occupy 14.817 MB. Detector checkpoint test mAP at 0.5 IoU is 0.7388, while the separately evaluated rectangular ONNX export achieves validation mAP at 0.5 IoU of 0.7367. Segmentation ONNX validation mIoU is 0.9750. A five-minute UNO Q recording produced median and 95th percentile pipeline latencies of 467.8 ms and 580.3 ms at a configured 0.5 Hz cadence. The evaluation also identifies black input misclassification and a sampling rate mismatch that prevents the diagnostic apparent motion estimator from collecting sufficient evidence. These results support an inspectable and reusable edge robotics foundation while clearly distinguishing model accuracy and on-board execution from validated on-water collision avoidance.

</details>


### [441] [Social Influence and the Allocation of Scientific Attention in AI Populations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22408)
*Maxim Chupilkin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将Music Lab实验范式迁移到"学术注意力市场"，让AI智能体从2025年AER的114篇文章中选择。社会信息使智能体选文总量减少17.2%、选择更集中、覆盖从90篇降至73篇，且初始选择被随机抬高后会显著提升后续被选率（+45.55个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统正日益参与科学研究的评价与使用，但它们面对的是围绕人类读者设计的引用量、下载量、热门榜单等信号。这些信号对"人工读者"群体的集体后果尚不明确，作者希望揭示简单社会信息规则如何塑造科学注意力的规模、广度与分布。

Method: 采用改编自Music Lab的市场设计。实验一：1000个AI智能体，从2025年AER全部114篇常规研究论文的标题与摘要中选择；设5个独立选择社区与5个社会影响社区，每社区100个顺序决策智能体，仅社会影响组可看到本社区先前选择，且智能体可选任意数量论文。实验二：200个智能体分布于20个社会社区，随机给某些论文5次初始选择，观察后续选择率。

Result: 社会信息社区每位智能体选文数减少17.2%，选择更集中，集体覆盖73篇（独立条件为90篇），社区间差异更大。实验二中，随机赋予的5次初始选择使论文后续被选率提高45.55个百分点（95% CI: 41.20–49.90）。选择与外部引用中度对应，与下载量几乎无关。

Conclusion: 结果表明，一个简单的社会信息规则即可显著影响人工群体对科学注意力的总量、广度和分布，产生强者愈强的集中效应，且这些AI选择信号与人类引用、下载指标仅弱相关。

Abstract: AI systems are becoming participants in the evaluation and use of scientific research. They encounter citation counts, download statistics and lists of popular articles developed around human readers, but the collective consequences of these signals for artificial readers remain uncertain. This paper adapts the Music Lab design to a market for academic attention. In the first experiment, 1,000 AI agents choose papers from the titles and abstracts of all 114 regular research articles published in the American Economic Review in 2025. The experiment has five independent-choice communities and five social-influence communities, each with 100 sequential agents. Only agents in the social-influence condition observe earlier selections within their community. Agents may select any number of papers. Social-information communities select 17.2 percent fewer papers per agent, concentrate their choices more heavily, and collectively cover 73 papers, compared with 90 independently. Between-community variation is greater under social information. In a second experiment with 200 agents across twenty social communities, randomly assigning papers five initial selections raises their subsequent selection rate by 45.55 percentage points (95% CI: 41.20 to 49.90). Choices have modest correspondence with external citations and little correspondence with download counts. The results show how a simple information rule shapes the volume, breadth and distribution of scientific attention in an artificial population.

</details>


### [442] [Testing, not presuming, adequacy: calibrating generative social simulators against emergent network structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24012)
*Tengfei Shao,Chao Li,Xu Wang,Masayuki Goto*

Main category: cs.AI
